gm.title: Description
lines: A six-legged ambush predator that buries itself in loose ground or waits on dark stone ledges. It interrogates captured prey by wrapping its antennae around the victim’s head.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands all languages and cannot speak.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Mandibles attack and use Mind-Probing Antennae or, if recharged, Paralyze.
Mandibles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage and is grappled (escape DC 11). The target takes another 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage at the start of each of the gaj's turns while held. The gaj can attack only the held creature with its mandibles until that grapple ends.
Mind-Probing Antennae. One creature grappled by the gaj makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage and the gaj magically learns one piece of information it seeks from the creature's mind. On a success, it takes half damage and reveals nothing.
Paralyze (Recharge 6). The gaj magically targets one creature it can see within 60 ft. The target must pass a DC 12 Wisdom save or become paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

lines: A living boulder keeps watch over isolated rocky sites. It can set nearby stones rolling against intruders.

lines: An animate boulder with a face and stone limbs that can tuck in and roll.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft. Passive Perception 11.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for an ordinary boulder.
Rolling Charge. After rolling at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, a Slam hit against it on the same turn deals an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit this way also makes a DC 16 Strength save or falls Prone.
Stone Guardian. It does not age or need sustenance. When it dies, it remains bound to the Material Plane.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Animate Boulders (1/day). Choose up to two visible boulders within 60 ft. Each uses the galeb duhr's statistics with Intelligence and Charisma 1. The boulders cannot be Charmed or Frightened, and they cannot use Animate Boulders. They stay animated while the galeb duhr maintains Concentration as on a spell, up to 1 minute.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Roll at 30 ft., or 60 ft. downhill. After rolling straight toward a creature for at least 20 ft., a same-turn Slam hit adds 7 (2d6) bludgeoning. The target must pass a DC 16 Strength save or fall Prone.

lines:

1st level, 4 slots. Animal Friendship, Cure Wounds, Entangle, Fog Cloud.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Staff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Wing Flap. Rise up to half the creature’s movement speed. This can extend a regular jump and is unavailable while gliding.
Spirit Totem. Once per short or long rest, place a spectral beast at a visible point within 60 ft. It creates a 30-ft.-radius aura and lasts for 1 minute. It counts as neither an object nor a creature. The druid can spend another bonus action to move it to a different point within 60 ft.
Bear Spirit. The druid and allies in the aura gain 9 temporary HP and have advantage on Strength checks and saves.
Hawk Spirit. The druid and allies in the aura have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. The druid can use a reaction to give an ally advantage on an attack against a target in the aura.
Unicorn Spirit. When a spell that expends a slot heals the druid or allies in the aura, each creature the druid chooses also regains 4 HP.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Glide. When falling at least 10 ft., use a reaction to fly in one direction up to the creature’s speed while descending. Land in an empty space and take no falling damage. Heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields prevent this, but the creature can drop held items as part of the reaction.

Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Graceful Step. Move 40 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.
Inspiring. One ally who can see and hear the monk can add a d4 roll to their next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Wing Flap. Rise up to half the monk's movement speed. This can extend a normal jump but cannot be used while gliding.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Glide. If the monk falls at least 10 ft., they can use their reaction to fly in one direction up to their speed as they descend. They land in an empty space and take no falling damage. gm.title: Description
lines: Born among giants, a gargantua develops horns and purple skin as it reaches adulthood. It can grow past forty feet tall and often settles far from other giants.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Weird Aura. At the start of the gargantua’s turn, each creature it chooses within 30 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage and is frightened until the start of its next turn. It sees the gargantua as the embodiment of its worst fears. A successful save grants immunity to this gargantua’s aura for 24 hours.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Slam or Rock.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +15 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines:
Baleful Hex. Choose one creature the gargantua can see within 120 ft. It must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Teleport. The gargantua and its worn or carried equipment teleport to a visible, unoccupied space within 120 ft.

gm.title: Reactions
lines:
Flick. Immediately after a visible creature of Large size or smaller within 20 ft. damages the gargantua, the creature makes a DC 23 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 18 (3d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 100 ft. horizontally away from the gargantua, and falls prone.
Spell Mimicry (1/day). Immediately after a visible creature casts a spell of 5th level or lower, it makes a DC 19 Charisma save. On a failure, the gargantua casts the same spell at the same level, chooses the targets, and needs no material components. Use +11 to hit with spell attacks or DC 19 for a spell saving throw.

lines:
Roll 1d6 or choose an appearance.
1. A smiling cherub.
2. Rough stone that looks barely carved.

lines:

gm.title: Description
lines: This carved guardian watches its assigned building from the eaves.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +5. AC +1 Dex, +11 natural. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 21. Base attack +8, grapple +16. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +3.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +8 melee for 2d6 + 8. Full attack makes two slams at the same bonus and damage.
Pounce (Ex). On the first round of combat, make one slam against a creature within 100 ft. If it hits after leaping down, add the falling damage the golem would have taken. Divide that extra damage between the target and their armor, shield or weapon, prioritizing items in that order.
Petrify (Su). A target hit by both slams in the same round must succeed on a DC 15 Fortitude save or turn to stone. The golem attempts a coup de grace against the statue the next round. If the target dies, only true resurrection, wish or miracle can restore it.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Damage reduction 10/magic. Immune to falling damage.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells, spell-like abilities and supernatural effects, with named exceptions. Soften earth and stone deals 2d8 damage without a save. Earthquake targeted on the golem destroys it. A targeted dispel magic at DC 16 disables it for a number of rounds equal to the caster's dispel check result minus 10. A result at least 10 above the DC destroys it. Detect magic reveals its aura returning while it is disabled.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.

gm.title: Dread golem commands
lines: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +13, Hide +6, Jump +13, Listen +5. Improved Initiative, Power Attack.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground. Solitary, always neutral, no treasure. Advances to 11–15 HD (Medium) or 16–25 HD (Large).

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed +8 melee slam is lower than its base attack plus Strength. Use the printed attack line. The pounce rules do not give an exact division of extra falling damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: A sentient white rose bush senses visitors through scent and empathy. It gives up one flower a week to protect someone from the Red Curse.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Rare, solitary, active by day in forest. Chaotic good. Intelligence 5–7. Steady morale 11–12. No treasure or magic resistance.

gm.title: Actions
lines: The bush has no normal attack. It uses its Legacies if someone uproots it or takes a second rose within a week. Its song can charm monsters within 1 mile and turn them against its foes.

gm.title: Defensive Legacies
lines: Acid Touch deals 1d4 plus 1 per HD on a hit. Entangle creates tentacles 5 feet long per 3 HD, to a maximum of 25 feet, for 1 round per level. An entangled target needs a successful bend bars roll to escape. Poison adds 1d6 damage to a natural physical attack other than a bite and can also cause sleep, paralysis, damage or death depending on HD. A save vs. poison halves the effect. Weaken reaches 10 yards. On a failed save vs. spell, the target counts as Strength 5 and takes −2 to attacks and −1 per damage die for 1 round per level.

gm.title: Plucked rose
lines: The flower protects as one ounce of cinnabryl. Its last petal drops at the end of day seven. The bearer cannot use Legacies while protected by the rose.

gm.title: Experience
lines: Award 35 XP once for encountering the bush or using a rose. Destroying the bush earns no XP.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The appendix gives the song a 1-mile radius without specifying a save, duration or use limit. Its generic Poison rule lists possible effects by HD without giving a full tier table.

gm.title: Description
lines: A fiendish hound said to descend from Hel’s own. Its howl can shake stone and help it corner prey underground.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 17, Stealth 12. Immune to necrotic and poison damage, Exhaustion, Paralyzed, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Understands Infernal without speaking. Telepathy 60 ft.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +3, Cha -1

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Maggoty Hide. When a creature within 5 ft. makes a melee attack against the garmr, it makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. If it fails, maggots infest it for 3 (1d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the infestation. Taking at least 5 acid or fire damage also destroys the maggots. After the creature saves or the maggots are destroyed, it is immune to this trait for 1 hour.
Pack Tactics. Has advantage on an attack if an ally within 5 ft. of the target is not Incapacitated.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Earth Rending Howl (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 20-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Strength save. Failure deals 17 (5d6) thunder damage and makes it Deafened for 1 minute. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition. Unattended objects and structures take double damage with no save or damage threshold.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Rotten Shake (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or suffers Maggoty Hide.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.
Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Description
lines: A beholder relative with six eyestalks and a hunger for the power stored in magic items.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Stunning Gaze. When a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see the central eye, the gauth can force a DC 14 Wisdom save if it can see the creature and isn't incapacitated. Failure stuns the creature until the start of its next turn. A creature that is not surprised can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the save. It then cannot see the gauth until its next turn starts, when it can avert its eyes again. Looking at the gauth sooner requires the save immediately.
Death Throes. The gauth releases explosive magical energy when it dies. Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 13 (3d8) force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d8) piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Roll three d6s, rerolling duplicates, for three magical rays. Choose one to three creatures the gauth can see within 120 ft.
1. Devour Magic Ray. On a failed DC 14 Dexterity save, a randomly selected magic item of the target loses its magical properties until the start of the gauth's next turn. Exclude single-use items such as potions and scrolls. An item with charges also loses 1d4 charges.
2. Enervation Ray. DC 14 Constitution save. A failure deals 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and a success halves it.
3. Fire Ray. A failed DC 14 Dexterity save deals 22 (4d10) fire damage.
4. Paralyzing Ray. A failed DC 14 Constitution save paralyzes the target for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
5. Pushing Ray. A failed DC 14 Strength save pushes the target up to 15 ft. away and halves its speed until the start of the gauth's next turn.
6. Sleep Ray. A failed DC 14 Wisdom save leaves the target asleep and unconscious for 1 minute. Damage or an action from another creature to wake it ends the sleep. Constructs and undead are unaffected.

gm.title: Traits
lines:

It then cannot see the gauth until its next turn begins and must make the save immediately if it looks at the gauth sooner.

gm.title: Actions

gm.title: Eye ray outcomes mechanics
lines:

Enervation Ray (2). DC 14 Constitution save. The target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
Pushing Ray (3). On a failed DC 14 Strength save, the target moves up to 15 ft. straight away from the gauth and its speed drops by half until the start of the gauth's next turn.
Fire Ray (4). On a failed DC 14 Dexterity save, the target takes 22 (4d10) fire damage.

Sleep Ray (6). On a failed DC 14 Wisdom save, the target falls unconscious for 1 minute. Damage or another creature spending an action to wake the target ends the sleep. Constructs and undead are unaffected.

gm.title: Magical metabolism

gm.title: Description
lines: A tiny creature born from a beholder's dreams. It mimics overheard speech and follows its creator around the lair.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A tiny, floating sphere with one central eye, a toothy mouth and four smaller eyes on stalks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Mimicry. The gazer imitates simple speech sounds it has heard in any language. A listener recognizes the imitation on a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Roll two d4s, rerolling duplicates, for two magical rays. Choose one or two targets the gazer can see within 60 ft.
1. Dazing Ray. A creature that fails a DC 12 Wisdom save is charmed until the start of the gazer's next turn. While charmed this way, its speed is halved and its attack rolls have disadvantage.
2. Fear Ray. A creature that fails a DC 12 Wisdom save is frightened until the start of the gazer's next turn.
3. Frost Ray. A failed DC 12 Dexterity save deals 10 (3d6) cold damage.
4. Telekinetic Ray. A Medium or smaller creature that fails a DC 12 Strength save moves up to 30 ft. directly away. The gazer can move a Tiny object up to 30 ft. in any direction if the object is neither worn nor carried. It can also manipulate a simple tool or open a container.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Aggressive. Move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

gm.title: Gazer familiar (optional)
lines: A gazer can form a telepathic bond with a willing master who is at least a 3rd-level spellcaster. The master can use the gazer's senses while the two are within 1 mile of each other. Physical harm from the master ends the gazer's service and breaks the bond.

gm.title: Applying the encounter template
lines: Choose a base creature with Charisma at least 6 from aberration, animal, dragon, giant, humanoid, magical beast, monstrous humanoid or shapechanger. Its type becomes undead with the incorporeal subtype. Keep size, saves and applicable base statistics, but remove prior attacks and special abilities, Strength and Constitution. HD becomes d12; Charisma rises by 2; fly 30 ft. perfect or keep a higher fly speed. Natural armor applies only to ethereal encounters. Add +8 racial bonuses to Hide, Listen, Search and Spot. The listed common geist uses Mind Games and Phantom Shift. CR 1/2; ability DC equals 10 + half HD + Cha modifier.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Ooze Cube. The cube takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube’s Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube can be seen but have total cover. A creature within 5 feet of the cube can take an action to pull a creature or object out of the cube. Doing so requires a successful DC 12 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 10 (3d6) acid damage. The cube can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. Transparent. Even when the cube is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a cube that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the cube’s space while unaware of the cube is surprised by the cube.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Pseudopod. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage. Engulf. The cube moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures’ spaces. Whenever the cube enters a creature’s space, the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the cube. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the cube enters the creature’s space, and the creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can’t breathe, is restrained, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube’s turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the cube.

gm.title: Description
lines: An archdevil who hunts from the fortress of Coldsteel and contests Levistus for control of Stygia.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Geryon fails a save, he can spend a use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Geryon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Geryon regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Radiant damage suppresses the trait at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn at 0 hit points and does not regenerate.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Claw and one Stinger attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (4d6 + 9) cold damage. A Large or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 24) and restrained until the grapple ends. Geryon can grapple only one creature at a time. A target already in his grapple takes an extra 27 (6d8) cold damage.
Stinger. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. A hit deals 14 (2d4 + 9) force damage. On a failed DC 21 Constitution save, the target also takes 13 (2d12) poison damage and is poisoned until it finishes a short or long rest. Reduce its hit point maximum by half the poison damage it took until the poisoned condition ends. It dies if this reduces its hit point maximum to 0.
Teleport. Geryon and his worn or carried equipment teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 21). No material components are required.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium when changing his appearance), Detect Magic, Ice Storm, Invisibility (self only), Locate Object, Suggestion, Wall of Ice.
1/day. Banishment.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
3 actions. Spend the indicated cost for one option at the end of another creature's turn. Regain spent actions at the start of Geryon's turn. Geryon cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Infernal Glare (1 action). Choose one creature Geryon can see within 60 ft. A failed DC 23 Wisdom save leaves it frightened of him until the end of its next turn.
Teleport (1 action). Use Teleport.
Swift Sting (2 actions). Make one Stinger attack.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option while Geryon is in the lair and able to act. He cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before taking a lair action.
Banish. Cast Banishment.
Chill Blast. Choose a point Geryon can see within 120 ft. A blast of cold rises from the ground in a 10-ft. cube centered there. A creature in the cube that fails a DC 21 Constitution save takes 28 (8d6) cold damage.
Hateful Restraints. A creature Geryon can see within 60 ft. must pass a DC 21 Wisdom save or be restrained for 1 minute. The target can end the effect on itself by dealing any damage to one or more of its allies.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects within 1 mile of the lair.
Chilling Wind. Strong, freezing winds blow throughout the area.
Enervating Screams. Howls fill the air. A creature that finishes a short or long rest must pass a DC 21 Wisdom save to gain any benefit.
Hellish Doorways. Sapient creatures frequently see portals that seem to lead to places they consider safe. Anyone who crosses a portal arrives somewhere in Stygia.
The effects fade over 1d10 days if Geryon dies.

gm.title: Sound the Horn (optional)
lines: Once per day, Geryon can sound his horn as an action, summoning 5d4 minotaurs into unoccupied spaces he chooses within 600 ft. They roll initiative on arrival and obey him. Each remains until it dies or until Geryon uses an action to dismiss some or all of them.

lines: Withering Touch. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage. Etherealness. The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can’t affect or be affected by anything on the other plane. Horrifying Visage. Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost’s Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring. Possession (Recharge 6). One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn’t deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can’t be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target’s statistics, but doesn’t gain access to the target’s knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost’s Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

The ghost’s game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target’s Speed, as well as the target’s Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the ghost leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost’s Possession for 24 hours. Success: The target is immune to this ghost’s Possession for 24 hours.

lines: A lingering soul bound to a person, place, or object that mattered in life.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Ethereal Sight. It can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane and 60 ft. into the Material Plane from the Ethereal Plane.
Incorporeal Movement. Treat creatures and objects as difficult terrain when passing through them. Ending a turn inside an object deals 5 (1d10) force damage to this creature.
Undead Nature. It can exist without air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Withering Touch. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
Etherealness. The ghost moves between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane. Creatures can see the ghost from the Material Plane when it is in the Border Ethereal and from the Border Ethereal when it is on the Material Plane. Effects cannot reach in either direction across the planar boundary.
Horrifying Visage. Each non-undead creature within 60 ft. that can see the ghost makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is Frightened for 1 minute. If that save fails by 5 or more, it also ages 1d4 × 10 years. While Frightened, it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition. A successful save or the end of the effect grants 24 hours of immunity to this ghost's Horrifying Visage. Greater Restoration reverses the aging if cast within 24 hours of the aging.
Possession (recharge 6). Choose one visible Humanoid within 5 ft. On a failed DC 13 Charisma save, the ghost disappears into the target and controls its body. The target is Incapacitated and remains aware. Only effects that turn undead can target the ghost while it possesses the body. The ghost keeps its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being Charmed or Frightened. For everything else it uses the host's statistics, with no access to the host's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. Possession ends when the body reaches 0 HP, the ghost leaves as a bonus action, an effect turns the ghost, or an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good forces it out. The ghost then returns to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the body. For 24 hours after a successful initial save or the end of possession, the target is immune to Possession by that ghost.

lines: Resolving the ghost's unfinished business can end the haunting. An object, event, or sensation linked to its former life may also expose a weakness.

lines: A Dazed creature chooses just one of movement, an action, or a bonus action on its turn. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, the turn ends. gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines:
Undead traits and +2 turn resistance.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Bite +8 melee for 1d6 + 2.
Full attack. Bite +8 melee for 1d6 + 2 and two claws +10 melee for 1d4 + 4 each. Alternatively, use the masterwork bastard sword +14 melee for 1d10 + 8 or the masterwork shortbow +10 ranged for 1d6. The bite carries paralysis and fever, and the claws carry paralysis.
Paralysis (Su). A bite or claw hit requires a DC 14 Fortitude save or paralysis lasts 1d6 + 6 minutes.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid or monstrous humanoid killed by fever at Constitution 0 rises as a ghoul lord after 24 hours if the body has not been destroyed. Someone slain directly by a bite or claw rises as a ghast after 1d4 days. Spawn serve their creator until it dies.

gm.title: Ravenous fever
lines: A bite can spread this supernatural disease. Fortitude DC 20, incubation 1d4 days, damage 1d4 Constitution. Once infected, a victim needs raw flesh daily. The amounts in pounds, Fine through Colossal, are 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32. After more than 2 Constitution damage from the disease only humanoid flesh suffices. After more than 5 only flesh from living humanoids suffices. Going hungry for a day deals 1d4 temporary Constitution damage and calls for a Madness save, DC 10 + the Constitution damage suffered. Failure temporarily compels the victim to try to feed. Only heal cures the disease.

gm.title: Adapting the encounter
lines: For a different humanoid or monstrous humanoid base, change its type to undead, keep size, speed, and saves, convert current and future Hit Dice to d12, and add +4 natural armor. A base creature with a swim speed retains it and is called a lacedon lord. Keep base attacks and add missing claws and bite. Base bite/claw damage by size, Fine to Colossal: 1/none, 1d2/1, 1d3/1d2, 1d4/1d3, 1d6/1d4, 1d8/1d6, 2d6/2d4, 2d8/2d6, 4d6/2d8. Use better existing natural damage if applicable. Str +2, Dex +4, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4. Remove Con. Add Multiattack and +8 racial bonuses to Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. CR increases by 2. Miasma and paralysis DCs are 10 + half HD + Cha modifier.

lines:

Hungry Dead Nature. The ghoul needs no air or sleep. If it goes 24 hours without eating 2 lb. of raw meat, it loses Exhaustion immunity and risks starvation until it eats that amount. If starvation has already given it Exhaustion, it cannot remove those levels until it eats at least 4 lb. of raw meat.

Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks. When the Bite and at least one Claw hit the same target other than a Construct or Undead, that target makes a DC 14 Constitution save or contracts Ghoul Hunger.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage. A creature other than a Construct or Undead also makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 minute. While Poisoned by this attack, it takes 2 (1d4) radiant damage at the start of each turn. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Startling Lunge. Choose a visible creature within 15 ft. and move up to 15 ft. toward it without provoking opportunity attacks. If the ghoul moves within 5 ft. of the target, it makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. Failure gives the ghoul advantage on its next attack roll against that target before the end of the ghoul’s next turn.

gm.title: Ghoul Hunger
lines: The Block references the Monster Vault sidebar. As a table fallback, the published Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.1 disease makes the infected creature Poisoned until cured. Eating any Humanoid flesh suppresses that condition for 1 hour. Every 12 hours, make a DC 13 Constitution save with disadvantage if the creature ate Humanoid flesh while infected. Failure lowers maximum HP by 7 (2d6) until a long rest after the cure, and maximum HP 0 kills it. Two successful saves cure the disease. After two failures or death while infected, it becomes a ghoul, or an ashrat if its proficiency bonus is +4 or higher. Wish or magic of similar strength can undo the transformation.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.
Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Goose Egg Trinket
lines:
Roll d12.
1. Empty shell with a poem or detailed artwork on the inside.
2. A candy egg.
3. A toy goose that honks when squeezed.
4. A Potion of Giant Strength (hill giant), without a bottle.
5. A Pearl of Power.
6. A Brooch of Shielding.
7. A Figurine of Wondrous Power (silver raven) that activates as the egg opens, releasing what looks like a living bird.
8–12. Empty.

lines:

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.

gm.title: Description
lines: Jotun claim the oldest mountain and glacier halls in the North. The giants keep secrets from before the present age and plot against the gods who displaced them.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Perception 15, Stealth 16. Immune to cold and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Darkvision 120 ft. Languages Common and Giant.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +14, Dex -1, Con +13, Int +4, Wis +12, Cha +9

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Giant Attributes. Resistant to Stunned and vulnerable to Prone. It has advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Stunned, and disadvantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Prone.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Resistance. The jotun has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Material Bound. Effects cannot force the jotun off the Material Plane against its will. It has disadvantage on saves against effects that would return it there from another plane.
Too Big to Notice. Stealth becomes 21 while the jotun holds still in nonmagical natural terrain.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Greatclub or Rock in any combination. One can be replaced with Icy Sweep or a casting of Fear.

Spellcasting. Wisdom (spell save DC 20), no material components. At will: Bestow Curse, Earthquake, Fear, Gust of Wind, and Speak with Animals.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Rock Catching. When a ranged weapon attack hits the jotun, it can catch the weapon or ammunition to reduce the attack’s damage by 38 (1d20 + 28). If this brings the damage to zero, it can throw what it caught at a creature within 60 ft., using the original attack roll and damage.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
The jotun has three legendary actions. It can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Hurl. Make one Rock attack.
Smash. Make one Greatclub attack.
Titanic Power. Use Spellcasting or an available Icy Sweep.

On further failures, the GM worsens the alteration or adds another. A 4th-order or higher Cure Ailment, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect reverses the alterations. lines:

lines:

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Damage reduction 10/magic. Fast healing 2 in direct sunlight or within the radius of daylight or a similar spell. For bludgeoning weapons, double damage that gets past its damage reduction.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells, spell-like abilities and supernatural effects, with named exceptions. After shatter hits the golem, every subsequent physical hit for rounds equal to the spell's caster level forces a Fortitude save at DC 5 + damage dealt. Failure destroys it. Mending restores full HP. A targeted dispel magic at DC 14 disables it for a number of rounds equal to the caster's dispel check result minus 10. A result at least 10 above the DC destroys it. lines: One of two glass pegasi that pull Zybilna’s flying crystal carriage. The carriage key wakes them and gives the driver reins made of starlight.

lines: AC 15 while animated, AC 13 while inanimate.

lines: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but cannot speak.

lines: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Carriage harness
lines: Hold the carriage key within 3 inches of either door to reveal a keyhole. Turning it clockwise unlocks both doors and animates the pegasi. The driver gains starlight reins and can move the carriage 40 ft. on land or 80 ft. in flight. While the carriage is stationary on the ground, turning the key counterclockwise locks the doors and returns the pegasi to statues. The vehicle and both pegasi shatter if the carriage leaves the Feywild.

gm.title: Description
lines: Bavlorna’s stuffed cat comes to life when someone opens her potion cabinet. It once belonged to Endelyn and is hostile to everyone except Bavlorna.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Keen Smell. Gloam has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. A hit deals 1 slashing damage.
Cloud of Dust (encounter trigger). On Gloam’s first turn in combat or when it drops to 0 hit points, it releases a cloud that works like Dust of Sneezing and Choking. Gloam and creatures within 30 ft. that need to breathe make a DC 15 Constitution save. A creature that fails is incapacitated and suffocating. While conscious, it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. A success or Lesser Restoration ends the effect. Under the 2014 suffocation rule, a choking creature lasts a number of rounds equal to its Constitution modifier, with a minimum of one round. It then starts its next turn dying at 0 hit points and cannot heal or stabilize while it still cannot breathe.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: A mute illusionist that escapes in the form of a floating light. It needs a living response at the door before it can enter.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Fledgling sample, 5th-level gnome illusionist. Initiative +9. Touch AC 16, flat-footed AC 18. BAB +2, grapple +5. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +9, Will +9.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +2 melee (1d4 − 1 and 1d4 permanent Dexterity drain to a living target), dagger +2 melee (1d4 − 1), or +1 light crossbow +9 ranged (1d8, 19–20/×2).
Mocking Grin (Su). Once per 10 minutes, standard action. Anyone within 30 ft. who sees its face makes a DC 13 Will save or suffers hideous laughter for 1d6 rounds as if cast at level 12. Different creature types get no save bonus. The fledgling deals 1d4 damage each round they laugh.
Animal Domination (Su). Standard action on an animal within 30 ft. that the vampire can look at. Will DC 13 or fall under domination as dominate person at caster level 12.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living target in a grapple. Each round the pin holds, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP.
Disguise Self (Sp). At will as a standard action, caster level 12, with indefinite duration. Innate spell-like ability saves use 11 + spell level.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines: Printed slots 5/5/4/3 at levels 0–3, DC 14 + spell level. 0: dancing lights, detect magic, ghost sound, mage hand, prestidigitation. 1: color spray, feather fall, magic missile, unseen servant, ventriloquism. 2: glitterdust, hypnotic pattern, levitate, mirror image. 3: displacement, invisibility sphere, stinking cloud. It is mute and must use Silent Spell for spells with verbal components. Its printed gear includes a wand of burning hands and potions of cat’s grace and invisibility.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 10/silver and magic, resistance 20 to cold, electricity and fire, fast healing 3, turn resistance +4, rat familiar, undead traits. Metal weapons pass through it. Extra damage from a magical weapon, such as fire, can still hurt it. Automatically disbelieves illusions. Spider climb works only on inorganic surfaces. Spectral Form is a standard action. It becomes an incorporeal light indefinitely and flies 20 ft. (perfect), but cannot cross force effects, living creatures, or once-living material.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: It creates no vampire spawn. To create a gnomish vampire, drain a gnome with 5 HD or more to Constitution 0 or less and lie over the corpse in its own sarcophagus for three full days without leaving. The new vampire remains controlled until its creator dies.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: Silver-backed mirrors and clearly presented holy symbols repel it. A displayed jewel forces a Will save against the presenter’s Charisma check or it stares for 2d4 rounds. An attack ends this immediately. It cannot enter a building until it knocks once and a living creature answers. At 0 HP it escapes in spectral form, reaching its coffin within 2 hours or dying. After 1 hour inside it reaches 1 HP and resumes fast healing. Direct sunlight destroys it unless it escapes in a single standard action. A silver spike through the heart kills it while left in place. The book gives a burial ritual requiring its hands boiled for 24 hours in a volcanic spring and its eyes replaced with gems worth at least 100 gp each before sealing its masterwork wooden coffin.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Craft (alchemy) +14, Bluff +9, Concentration +9, Hide +13, Knowledge (undead lore) +9, Listen +16, Move Silently +13, Search +14, Sense Motive +12, Spellcraft +14, Spot +14. Alertness, Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Scribe Scroll, Silent Spell, Toughness.

gm.title: Encounter adaptation
lines: Apply the strain to the 3.5 vampire template. Retain unmodified abilities, size, BAB, saves and skill points. The base vampire uses undead d12 Hit Dice and has no Constitution score. Keep an existing swim speed and ignore vulnerability to immersion in running water if the base creature can swim. Use save DC 10 + half HD rounded down + Charisma modifier unless specified. Age rows replace one another. Apply only to a gnome. Age DR requires silver and magic.

gm.title: Age modifiers
lines:
Apply one row to a base creature. The sample already includes its adjustments. Ability scores are listed in Str, Dex, Int, Wis, Cha order.
Fledgling. Abilities 0/6/2/6/4. Speed +0 ft., natural AC +6, turn resistance +4, CR +1. DR 10, fast healing 3, laugh damage 1d4.
Mature. Abilities 0/8/2/8/4. Speed +10 ft., natural AC +6, turn resistance +4, CR +1. DR 15, fast healing 3, laugh damage 1d6.
Old. Abilities 2/8/4/8/6. Speed +10 ft., natural AC +7, turn resistance +5, CR +2. DR 15, fast healing 5, laugh damage 1d8.
Ancient. Abilities 2/10/4/10/6. Speed +20 ft., natural AC +7, turn resistance +5, CR +2. DR 20, fast healing 5, laugh damage 1d8.
Eminent. Abilities 4/10/6/10/8. Speed +20 ft., natural AC +8, turn resistance +6, CR +3. DR 20, fast healing 6, laugh damage 1d10.
Patriarch. Abilities 6/12/8/12/10. Speed +30 ft., natural AC +8, turn resistance +7, CR +4. DR 25, fast healing 8, laugh damage 1d10.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Conjuration and Necromancy are the sample’s printed prohibited schools, but its spell list includes Conjuration spells. The list preserves the printing. Under standard 3.5 preparation, select legal replacements using the sample’s slots and apply Silent Spell where required. Its printed grapple +5 is also inconsistent with its size and Strength.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Crafty. Leaving an enemy's reach doesn't trigger an opportunity attack.
Minion. Any attack or failed save that deals damage drops the lackey to 0 HP. Other damage kills it if the amount reaches 6 HP. Otherwise it ignores that damage.
Tiny Stabs. If an enemy begins its turn within 5 ft. of at least three lackeys who can see it, it must save Dexterity against DC 10 plus the number of lackeys within 5 ft. Failure deals 1 piercing damage per nearby lackey.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger (group attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five lackeys sharing a turn can each spend their action to attack a target in reach or range of each of them. Make one attack at +3 plus the number of participants. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage per participant. A lone lackey uses +3. Advantage or disadvantage applies to the group roll only if every participant has it. If the target has different cover or concealment against some attackers, split them into groups and roll separately.
Group opportunity attack. If a creature provokes from multiple lackeys at once, each may spend its reaction to join. Lackeys cannot score critical hits. If a response to the attack can affect only one attacker, the target chooses which participant it affects.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 6 damage leaves a surplus equal to the damage minus 6. Drop one eligible lackey for each 6 surplus damage or fraction thereof. Melee targets must be in reach of the weapon. Ranged targets must be on the line from the attacker through the original target and within the weapon's short range. This rule excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Description
lines: A gold dragon can become a greatwyrm by merging with its counterparts from other worlds. Its breath can burn an army or sap its strength.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Metallic Awakening (recharges after a short or long rest). When the greatwyrm would drop to 0 HP, set its current HP to 450, recharge Breath Weapon, and restore all spent uses of Legendary Resistance. It can use mythic actions for the next hour. If defeated after this trait activates, award 120,000 extra XP (240,000 total).
Unusual Nature. It needs no food or drink.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. A Huge or smaller creature is grappled (escape DC 20) and restrained until the grapple ends. The greatwyrm can hold one creature with this attack at a time.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 26 Strength save or fall prone.
Breath Weapon (recharge 5–6). Use Elemental Breath or Sapping Breath.
Elemental Breath. Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 84 (13d12) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Sapping Breath. Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Constitution save. On a failure it falls unconscious for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect on a success. On an initial success, it has disadvantage on attacks and saving throws until the end of the greatwyrm's next turn.
Change Shape. Magically become any Medium or Small creature. The greatwyrm retains its statistics except for size. The change ends if it reaches 0 HP or uses an action to end it.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The greatwyrm can spend up to 3 legendary actions, using one option at the end of another creature's turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Claw or Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 30 ft. must pass a DC 26 Dexterity save or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its fly speed.

gm.title: Mythic actions
lines:
For 1 hour after Metallic Awakening activates, the greatwyrm can spend legendary actions on these options.
Bite (1 action). Make one Bite attack.
Shattering Roar (2 actions). Each creature within 120 ft. must pass a DC 26 Constitution save or take 19 (3d12) thunder damage and be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Dragon customization
lines: Page 34 offers language and proficiency changes, alternate senses, and traits such as Flyby, Mimicry, Rejuvenation, and Tunneler. Charisma gives a spell save DC of 26 and a spell attack bonus of +18. This profile uses the printed actions unless you choose a variant.

gm.title: Description
lines: Savage Coast builders use glassteel, red steel and cut stone to make guards and siege engines.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Choose one printed form below. Use its listed attack routine and relevant defenses. These constructs have no Legacies or cinnabryl requirement.

gm.title: Aelder
lines: Lesser golem. AC 3, 9 HD, 60 HP, THAC0 11, movement 18, 2,000 XP. Two piercing front-leg strikes for 2d6 each reach 10 feet. In icy burial grounds, ranged attacks beyond 20 feet are impossible and nonmelee attacks within 20 feet take −2. Immune to light or gaze effects. Can cast color spray, dancing lights and hypnotic pattern three times each per day. A spider aelder spins thick glassteel webs for cover or nearly invisible brittle strands that shatter to alert it. Ee’aar priests create and command them in pairs. Large, neutral, fearless 19–20. No magic resistance or treasure.

gm.title: Glassine Horror
lines: Lesser golem. AC 2, 8 HD, 60 HP, THAC0 13, movement 9, fly 36, 4,000 XP. As an inactive sheet, it occupies 50–100 square feet across a window or doorway and is 1–6 inches thick. As a roughly 15-foot humanoid, it punches once for 2d10. Opponents within 10 feet save vs. spell or take −2 to attacks. It can use crystalbrittle, sunburst as a wand of illumination, and continual light in this form. It is immune to light and electricity spells while humanoid. In sand form it moves at 36, at most 5 feet above a surface. The 100-cubic-foot cloud deals 2d8 to a creature on a successful attack roll and blinds it for 2d4 turns on a failed save vs. spell. The cloud is immune to wind spells. It flees below 10% of starting HP and heals by resting or absorbing 50 gp in gems per HP. Usually alone or 1d6 under its creator’s command. Lawful neutral, average morale 8–10, treasure Q ×4. No magic resistance.

gm.title: Red Golem
lines: Greater golem. AC 1, 18 HD, 90 HP, THAC0 3, movement 6, 14,000 XP. Two punches for 2d12 each. Both must target the same foe while that foe is still standing. It attacks the greatest threat first. Cinnabryl within 10 feet loses 1 ounce each round without triggering the Time of Loss and Change. It requires a +2 weapon to hit and takes half weapon damage from enchantments below +4. Magical electricity slows it for 1d3 rounds. Magical fire heals 1 HP per damage die. Other spells fail against it. It uses taunt after a strike with a nonmagical weapon or a spell it is immune to. It can alter its size and appearance with shapechange only on its master’s command. Large, neutral, fearless 19–20. No magic resistance or treasure.

gm.title: Hulean Juggernaut
lines: Greater golem. AC 0, 30 HD, 150 HP, movement 9, 21,000 XP. Creatures in its path save vs. breath weapon to escape sideways or take 10d10 damage. Its wheelbase can crush multiple targets at once. A ram may break larger obstacles, and soldiers aboard can attack creatures that evade the wheels. It can stop, turn or reverse within one round. Immune to fire, sleep, charm, hold and nonmagical weapons. All its saves succeed on 4 or higher. It obeys only its creator’s simple verbal commands and may keep following the last order after the creator dies. Only the creator can authorize entry. Gargantuan, neutral, elite morale 13–14, treasure A and possible extras. No magic resistance.

Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Vine Whip attacks or three Fling Thorn attacks. The printed block permits replacing one Vine Whip with Thorned Embrace, whose mechanics are missing.
Vine Whip. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. A DC 14 Strength save prevents a pull of up to 10 ft. toward the golem. If the target was Medium or smaller and already within 5 ft., the golem can Grapple it instead, escape DC 14. A target held this way is Restrained. The golem can hold only one target this way.
Fling Thorn. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Entangling Roots. Plant both feet and extend roots. Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Strength save or is Grappled, escape DC 14. The roots release their targets if the golem uses this bonus action again.

gm.title: Reading Black Flag stat blocks
lines:
Rules source. Black Flag Reference Document, Monsters.
The printed modifiers and fixed HP are ready to use. For a Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid the creature, use its Perception value as the DC. For a Wisdom (Perception) check to detect it, use its Stealth value as the DC.
Condition resistance gives advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the named condition. Condition vulnerability gives disadvantage. Apply damage resistance and vulnerability to the amount of damage instead.

gm.title: Table notes

1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Entangle, Ray of Sickness.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage when wielding it with two hands.
Fungal Rot. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target also makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failure or half that damage on a success.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Feed on Death. When a creature within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, the shaman gains 5 (1d10) temporary hit points.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
Golgari Lairs. These actions belong to a group of six or more Golgari defending their territory. At least one defender must be Jarad Vod Savo, a Golgari Shaman, a Kraul Death Priest, an Undercity Medusa, or a Devkarin Lich. Count the lair as one additional CR 1 creature when estimating encounter difficulty.
On initiative count 20, losing ties, the group uses one lair action. It must choose a different option from the one used the previous round.
Sewer Overflow. Sewage spills from sewer openings the Golgari can see. A creature within 20 ft. of an affected opening must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or fall prone and be pushed up to 20 ft. straight away from that opening.
Spore Cloud. Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere within 120 ft. of any member of the group. The spores spread around corners and lightly obscure the area. A creature inside when the cloud appears makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half that damage on a success. A creature ending its turn inside takes 10 (3d6) poison damage. The cloud lasts until a Golgari defender dismisses it as an action, the group uses this option again, or all defenders die.
Fungal Tendrils. Center a 15-ft.-radius sphere within 60 ft. of any member of the group. Creatures in it who are not allied with the group must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or become restrained. An affected creature can use its action to end the restraint on itself with a successful DC 15 Strength check. The restraint also ends if the group uses this option again, all defenders die, or no member remains within 60 ft. of the effect.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines: A Golgari lair produces one or both of these effects, only belowground. Moss and fungi cover underground surfaces within half a mile. When a Small or Medium humanoid dies within the lair, roll any die. On an odd result the corpse rises as a fungus drudge using the 2014 Zombie stat block after 1d8 hours, unless the body is destroyed first. If all Golgari in the lair die, its effects fade over 1d10 days.

lines: Shockwave (2nd-order power). Chosen creatures within 15 ft. make a DC 25 Strength save. On a failure, each takes 22 (4d10) force damage and is pushed up to 20 ft. directly away.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Volcanic Punishment. When damaged, Goxomoc teleports with creatures he is grappling into an unoccupied space he sees within 30 ft. Each creature within 10 ft. of the point he left makes a DC 27 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage or half on a success.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Rumble. Unworn and uncarried mundane objects within 90 ft. take 55 (10d10) force damage. Creatures within 90 ft. fall Prone and make DC 27 Dexterity saves. Those who fail become embedded in the ground and Restrained. A creature can use an action to free itself or a creature it can reach with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
2. Thunder. Teleport with creatures he is grappling to an unoccupied space he sees within 120 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. of either endpoint makes a DC 27 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage or half on a success.
3. Eruption. Enemies within 120 ft. make DC 25 Wisdom saves. Failure deals 44 (8d10) psychic damage and makes them vulnerable to all damage from Goxomoc until the end of his next turn. A success halves the damage.

At the party’s first visit three Zhentarim Assassins offer a ruby worth 500 gp for help finding Artus Cimber. Zitembe turns them away. The interruption leaves him inclined to help the party.
A convincing argument or a donation of at least 25 gp secures a 24-hour divination. He sees a southern jungle city ringed by cliffs and full of snakes, along with a vine-covered black obelisk. He urges the party to look for those landmarks.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, pp. 20–21 (Temple of Savras). Zitembe appears on p. 21. Uses Priest from Monster Manual (2014), p. 348.

gm.title: Medium size tier
lines:
Medium elemental (Earth, Mists). CR 3. 30 HP (4d8 + 12). Initiative −1. Speed 20 ft..
AC 18, touch 9, flat-footed 18. Base attack +3, grapple +8. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Attack Slam +8 melee (1d8 + 7). Full attack Slam +8 melee (1d8 + 7).
Fort +7, Ref +0, Will +1. Str 21, Dex 8, Con 17, Int 5, Wis 11, Cha 11. Listen +4, Spot +3.
Feats include Cleave, Power Attack. Advancement 5–7 HD, Medium.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Slam. Make one melee slam, or use the full-attack count in the chosen tier.
Earth Mastery (Ex). Gain +1 to attack and damage while both the elemental and its opponent touch the ground. Against a foe in the air or water, apply −4 instead. The attack lines do not include these modifiers.
Sink (Su, once per hour). Choose one opponent within 60 ft. who is standing on earth or stone. The target makes an opposed grapple check against the elemental. On failure, spectral arms hold it in place. A Medium target sinks to its knees in round 1 and cannot leave its square. If the elemental keeps concentrating, the target sinks to its waist in round 2 and loses its Dexterity bonus to AC. In round 3 it is pulled 6 ft. underground and stays in suspended animation until unearthed. Allies can attempt the 3.5 break another’s pin action to free it before burial.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Darkvision 60 ft. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, critical hits, and flanking. Does not eat, sleep, or breathe. It cannot be raised or resurrected, though limited wish, wish, miracle, or true resurrection can restore it. Moves through earth and stone and senses groundborne movement with tremorsense. It cannot travel through or across water.

gm.title: Dread elemental rules
lines:
Printed source. Elemental, Dread, p. 63, and Mists subtype, pp. 7–8.
In Ravenloft, calling a standard elemental has a 20% chance of producing a dread elemental. Summoning magic always produces the dread form. Accidental dread elementals are uncontrolled, and the Dark Powers supply the matching materials. Intentional conjuring requires the matching material and uses the usual chance for the elemental to break control.
Dread elementals understand speech but do not communicate. Their Mists subtype makes them native throughout Ravenloft and allows them to be summoned in any domain. A dismissed dread elemental returns to Ravenloft itself, so the realm's restrictions on calling do not break the calling pact.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The Large table prints DR 10/+1. A weapon with at least a +1 enhancement bypasses it. Huge, Greater, and Elder use the printed DR 10/—.
The book gives no tremorsense distance. Use 60 ft. as a table default. Sink explicitly gives its round-by-round effects for a Medium target only.

gm.title: Description
lines: This bone-flecked ooze tunnels into graves for the bodies. Disturbing it can leave a living intruder trapped in the same grave.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Land and underground, especially graves. Solitary. Always neutral. Standard treasure. Advancement 7–9 HD (Large), 10–18 HD (Huge).

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative −5. AC includes −1 size and −5 Dex, touch and flat-footed 4. Base attack +4, grapple +10. Printed space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +4, Ref −3, Will −3. No skills or feats.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Ooze traits. Immune to necromantic effects and piercing damage. Blindsight detects heat and motion within 60 ft., and the ooze smells rotting flesh through the earth from miles away. Its acid dissolves only organic material.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Slam +5 melee (2d4 + 3 plus 1d4 acid).
Improved Grab (Ex). After a slam hits, attempt a grapple without provoking an attack of opportunity.
Engulf (Ex). On a successful grapple check against a Medium or smaller creature, engulf it or drag it into the grave. Each engulfed victim is trapped, takes acid damage automatically each round, and is exposed to contact poison. Halve damage from attacks against the engulfing ooze and apply the other half to the victim.
Poison (Ex). Fort DC 15, Constitution-based. Both initial and secondary damage are 1d4 Str and 1d4 Con.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The book says Engulf deals acid damage but gives no separate amount. Use the slam’s 1d4 acid per round as a table default.

gm.title: Description
lines: An active grave scarab hunts warm flesh. A dormant survivor in a sealed tomb takes on a golden finish and can pass for jewelry until body heat wakes it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Desert and underground. Solitary or swarm of 10–100. Always neutral. No treasure, advancement, or level adjustment.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +2. Touch AC 20, flat-footed 22. Base attack +0, grapple −15. Space 1/2 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +0.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Climb +2, Hide +10, Listen +2, Spot +1. Weapon Finesse (bonus).

gm.title: Traits
lines: Tremorsense and vermin traits. The sense has no listed range. It attacks the closest food and can be lured away with another food source.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +10 melee (1d2 − 5, minimum 1 on a hit) plus flesh burrow.
Flesh Burrow (Ex). It travels along armor or similar material until it can reach bare skin. A successful attack roll lets it burrow toward the heart, dealing 1d4 hit point damage per round. It reaches the heart in 2 rounds for a Small target, 3 for Medium, or 4 for Large. Once there it inflicts 1d4 permanent Constitution damage each round. Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to this attack.
Removal. Cutting off the affected limb removes it. Attacks against a buried beetle target it without its Dexterity bonus and split damage evenly between beetle and host. A host attacking the beetle inside their own body takes −2 to attack and damage rolls.

gm.title: Description
lines: A floating mass of former cryptkeepers carrying lanterns whose beams have different effects.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saves Con +10, Wis +8, Cha +10. Perception +13. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 23. Understands all languages without speaking.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Dazzling Illumination. Sheds bright light for 60 ft. and imposes disadvantage on attacks against it. A hit disrupts the trait until the end of its next turn. It is also disrupted while it is Incapacitated or its speed is 0.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Slam. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target, 14 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) necrotic.
Lantern Blast. Every creature within 120 ft. without total cover rolls a d6 for the ray that strikes it. The save DC is 18. Failure deals 35 (10d6) damage of the listed type and applies that ray's effect. Table ruling. Success halves the damage and prevents the other effects for every ray.

gm.title: Lantern Blast Rays
lines:
1. Dispelling Blast. Intelligence save, psychic damage. End all spells and magical effects on the target and break its spell concentration.
2. Forceful Blast. Strength save, force damage. Push 20 ft. away and knock Prone.
3. Blinding Blast. Constitution save, radiant damage. Blinded for 1 minute. Repeat the save on each of the target's turns to end it.
4. Contamining Blast. Constitution save, necrotic damage and one level of Contamination.
5. Igniting Blast. Dexterity save, fire damage. The target also takes 35 (10d6) fire damage at the start of its turns until someone spends an action to douse it.
6. Freezing Blast. Constitution save, cold damage. No reactions until the end of the target's next turn. On that turn it can only do one of these: move, take an action, or take a bonus action.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Slam. Make one Slam attack.
Glide. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Lantern Blast (3 actions). Use Lantern Blast.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one effect. Each must be used before an effect repeats, and the same effect cannot occur in consecutive rounds.
Sludge Spout. A 10-ft.-radius, 30-ft.-high cylinder erupts. Creatures inside make a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 42 (12d6) necrotic damage and one level of Contamination. Success halves the damage.
Grasping Walls. Walls within 120 ft. grow arms. Chosen creatures starting a turn within 10 ft. of one make a DC 15 Dexterity save or become Grappled. Escape with a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Lantern. A torch or lantern in the room emits a Lantern Blast.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Slam preserves the printed average of 14 alongside the printed formula 4d8 + 4. For rolled damage, use the formula.
The successful save instruction follows ray 6 in the printing. This profile applies it to all six rays.

gm.title: Description
lines: A vengeful spirit pulls many corpses together into one body. It may hunt the people or institutions responsible for their deaths.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned, Unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Undead Restoration. Unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains, the revenant revives after 24 hours. It animates a different group of corpses elsewhere on the same plane, changes appearance, and returns at full HP with this stat block.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Suffocate attacks.
Suffocate. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage and 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is also Grappled (escape DC 15) and suffocates until that grapple ends. The revenant can grapple up to two targets with this attack at once.
Haunting Glare (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. Emanation from the revenant makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure, the creature is Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

gm.title: Description
lines: An ash-colored dream creature impersonates animals and bystanders. It flees if its disguise fails.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +0. AC 14 (+1 size, +3 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 14. Base attack +3, grapple +0. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +5 melee (1d3+1). Full attack. Two claws +5 melee (1d3+1 each).
Lullaby (Su). As a standard action, opponents within 20 ft. must make a DC 14 Will save. Failure fatigues them for 1d4 rounds or as long as the dream spawn keeps speaking within 20 ft. of them. Maintaining the lullaby is a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion.
Memory Drain (Su, 1/day). A successful touch attack deals 1d4 Intelligence damage. Until the victim recovers all of those points, the dream spawn can use Alternate Form to impersonate any creature from the victim's memory.
Alternate Form (Su). Use polymorph on itself as a standard action at caster level 8. The form can last indefinitely. Returning to its own shape is a free action.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/magic. Darkvision 60 ft. It does not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Detect Thoughts (Su). In an inhabited dreamscape, it knows a creature's surface thoughts as though it had studied them for three rounds with detect thoughts, caster level 3, Will DC 13. Fear Eater (Ex). Immune to Fear, Horror, and Madness. A spell targeting it that would normally cause one of those effects heals 1 HP per spell level. When one of its actions makes a dreamer fail a Fear, Horror, or Madness save, it heals 2 HP for a minor outcome, 4 HP for a moderate outcome, or 8 HP for a major outcome.

gm.title: Dream defeat
lines: A dreamer killed by this dream spawn takes a DC 12 Ravenloft Madness save on waking (Will). For consequences and recovery, use the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, chapter 3. A spawn that wins often returns to terrorize that dreamer again.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +2, Disguise +4, Hide +6, Listen +3, Move Silently +2, Sense Motive +3, Spot +3. Skill Focus (Disguise). Speaks Oneiros and the languages of its current prey.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Any land or underground (dreams). Solitary, pair, gang of 3–6, or pack of 9–20. No treasure. Always lawful neutral. Advances at 4–6 HD (Medium) or 7–9 HD (Large). If forced to fight, it resumes its natural form and claws its attacker.

gm.title: Description
lines: A slab-gray ooze that creeps along walls and corrodes armor with a touch.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
Corrosive Form. Destroy nonmagical ammunition immediately after it hits and deals damage to the ooze. When a nonmagical weapon touches the ooze and deals damage to it, the weapon immediately gains a cumulative −1 penalty to its attack rolls. At −5, the weapon is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from a surviving weapon. The ooze eats through 2 inches of nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Pseudopod. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it provides. If this lowers the armor's AC to 10, the armor is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from surviving armor.

gm.title: Description
lines: A mature gray ooze can develop enough intelligence to attack another creature's mind.

gm.title: Variant
lines: Uses the Gray Ooze base profile with Intelligence 6 and the additional Psychic Crush action.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Blindsight 60 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 8.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous. The ooze can pass through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Corrode Metal. After a hit from a nonmagical metal weapon, that weapon permanently loses 1 from its damage rolls. Penalties stack and destroy it at −5. Nonmagical metal ammunition is destroyed after it hits and deals damage. The ooze can eat through 2 inches of nonmagical metal in one round.
False Appearance. A motionless ooze looks like an oily puddle or wet rock.
Ooze Nature. It needs no sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. Nonmagical metal armor worn by the target takes a permanent, stacking −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor breaks once its AC drops to 10.
Psychic Crush (recharge 5–6). Choose one creature it senses within 60 ft. The creature makes a DC 10 Intelligence save, taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on failure or half on success.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Source variant of Gray Ooze. Check the variant rules for changes to actions and traits.
