gm.title: Description
lines: A gray render may offer to bond with an intelligent creature by warbling, scratching the earth, and bowing. Once bonded, it protects that creature fiercely, even when its behavior causes trouble outside combat.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength save or fall prone.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is prone, add 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Bloody Rampage. When the render takes damage, it makes one Claw attack against a random creature it can reach. Exclude the render's master.

gm.title: Gray Render Quirks
lines:
Choose a quirk or roll 1d12.
1. Detests riding animals.
2. Roars if another creature touches its master.
3. Wants to cuddle.
4. Pulls up trees to chew them.
5. Produces gas strong enough to make eyes water.
6. Offers meat to its master.
7. Digs wherever it goes.
8. Treats wagons and carts as enemies.
9. Howls in the rain.
10. Whimpers in darkness.
11. Buries any treasure it finds.
12. Leaps after birds even if it wrecks whatever is nearby.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 146.

gm.title: References
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 146 · https://5e.tools/bestiary.html#gray%20render_mpmm

gm.title: Description
lines: A gray render seeks an intelligent creature to bond with. It fiercely protects its master, but its impulses can wreak havoc among its allies.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target also makes a DC 16 Strength save, falling prone on a failure.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is prone, it also takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Bloody Rampage. When the render takes damage, it makes one Claws attack against a random creature in reach, excluding its master.

gm.title: Gray Render quirks
lines:
Choose a quirk or roll a d12.
1. Detests horses and other mounts.
2. Roars if anyone touches its master.
3. Wants to cuddle.
4. Pulls up trees to chew on them.
5. Passes gas strong enough to make eyes water.
6. Gives its master gifts of meat.
7. Digs whenever it can.
8. Attacks carts and wagons as though they were monsters.
9. Howls in rain.
10. Whimpers in darkness.
11. Buries any treasure it finds.
12. Leaps at birds without regard for what it breaks.

gm.title: Description
lines: A six-foot scavver that hunts in packs. The smell of blood draws it in, though a wounded scavver usually breaks off the attack.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unusual Nature. The gray scavver survives without air.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Roll with advantage if the target is a creature below its hit point maximum. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Spawning Stone or a slaad lord can turn a green slaad into a gray one. Gray slaadi search the planes for Humanoid settlements near portals.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Chaos Claw attacks.
Chaos Claw. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. Roll a d4 to determine the condition affecting the target until the start of the slaad's next turn. On 1 it is Charmed, on 2 Frightened, on 3 Poisoned, and on 4 Incapacitated.

lines:

gm.title: Slaad control gems
lines:
A slaad born from the Spawning Stone carries a magical control gem in its head. Once another creature claims the gem, the slaad is Charmed and obeys the bearer. It stops being Charmed if the bearer or the bearer's allies harm it, if someone returns the gem to the slaad, or if Greater Restoration destroys the gem when cast on the slaad.
Wish can retrieve the gem. If the slaad fails its save against Imprisonment, the caster gets the gem and the slaad stays free. Removing the gem from an Incapacitated slaad takes 1 minute and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure deals 22 (4d10) Piercing damage to the slaad.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action, the slaad can take the form of a Small or Medium humanoid or return to its true form. Only its size changes in its statistics. Its equipment keeps its own form. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The slaad’s weapon attacks count as magical.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
Control Gem. The slaad has a magical gem in its brain. It must obey the creature that possesses the gem and is immune to being Charmed for as long as the gem controls it. Destroying the gem ends this means of control.
Spell extraction. If the slaad fails a save against Imprisonment, the caster can have the spell move the gem to their open hand instead of imprisoning the slaad. Wish can retrieve the gem if cast in the slaad's presence with that wording. Greater Restoration cast on the slaad destroys the gem without injuring it.
Surgical extraction. A creature proficient in Wisdom (Medicine) can remove the gem while the slaad is Incapacitated. Each attempt takes 1 minute of uninterrupted work and a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. A failure deals 22 (4d10) psychic damage to the slaad.

lines: A slaad created by a Spawning Stone has a control gem. A slaad that was born another way develops one on contact with the stone. Whoever holds the extracted gem can command the slaad, which is immune to being Charmed while under that control.

Wish can recover a gem, Imprisonment can transfer it on a failed save, and Greater Restoration destroys it harmlessly. A trained healer can spend 1 minute attempting extraction from an Incapacitated slaad with a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. On failure the slaad takes 4d10 psychic damage.

gm.title: Description
lines: Graz’zt rules from the Argent Palace in Zelatar, in the Abyssal realm of Azzatar. His chosen forms share six digits on each hand and foot. He carries Angdrelve, the acid-dripping greatsword also called Wave of Sorrow.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Graz’zt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Graz’zt has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Wave of Sorrow attacks. Graz’zt can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.
Wave of Sorrow (Greatsword). Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) force damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage.
Teleport. Graz’zt and any equipment he wears or carries teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 23) without material components.
At will. Charm Person, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic.
3/day each. Darkness, Dominate Person, Telekinesis, Teleport.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Greater Invisibility.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Change Shape. Take a form resembling a Medium humanoid or return to his true form. His size changes with the form. His other statistics and his worn or carried equipment stay the same.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Negate Spell (Recharge 5–6). When Graz’zt sees a creature within 60 ft. casting a spell, he can try to interrupt it. A spell of 3rd level or lower fails automatically. For a spell of 4th level or higher, make a Charisma check against DC 10 + the spell’s level. On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Graz’zt has 3 legendary actions. Spend one at the end of another creature’s turn to use an option. He regains all spent actions at the start of his turn. He must be able to act and, if surprised, must finish his first turn before using an option.
Abyssal Magic. Use Spellcasting or the Teleport action.
Attack. Make one Wave of Sorrow attack.
Dance, My Puppet! Choose one creature Graz’zt can see that he has charmed. It must use its reaction to move up to its speed as he directs.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after anyone tied at that count, choose one option while Graz’zt is in his lair and able to act. He cannot repeat an option in consecutive rounds. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before taking a lair action.
Command. Cast Command on any creatures in the lair he chooses and knows are present. He can target creatures he cannot see and gives each target the same order.
Conjure Mirrors. Smooth surfaces in the lair become mirrorlike. Until he uses a different lair action, creatures in the lair have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or more effects for the area surrounding the lair. The effects fade over 1d10 days after Graz’zt dies.
Agitated Beasts. Wild beasts within 6 miles frequently fight and mate as if it were breeding season.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Wisdom (Insight) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks have advantage.
Mirrors Everywhere. Within 1 mile, flat stone and metal surfaces become supernaturally reflective.

gm.title: Cult
lines: See Cult of Graz’zt for his followers’ encounter rules.

lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 148.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Dark Prince rules from his Argent Palace in Zelatar. His cultists hide behind ornate masks, gather secrets, and turn other people’s appetites against them. He carries the acid-slick greatsword Angdrelve, also called Wave of Sorrow.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is nonmagical.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action, Graz’zt takes the form of a Medium humanoid or returns to his true form. Only his size changes. Worn and carried equipment keeps its form.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Graz’zt can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Graz’zt casts with Charisma (spell save DC 23) without material components.
At will. Charm Person, Crown of Madness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Dissonant Whispers.
3/day each. Counterspell, Darkness, Dominate Person, Sanctuary, Telekinesis, Teleport.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Greater Invisibility.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Wave of Sorrow attacks.
Wave of Sorrow (Greatsword). Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.
Teleport. Graz’zt and his worn or carried equipment magically move up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Graz’zt has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. Each option costs 1 action unless stated otherwise.
Attack. Make one Wave of Sorrow attack.
Dance, My Puppet! One creature Graz’zt can see that he has charmed must spend its reaction to move up to its speed as he directs.
Sow Discord. Cast Crown of Madness or Dissonant Whispers.
Teleport. Use the Teleport action.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after all creatures tied at that count, Graz’zt can choose one option. He cannot choose the same option two rounds in a row.
Command. He casts Command on any number of creatures he knows are in his lair, whether or not he can see them. All targets receive the same command.
Mirrored surfaces. Smooth surfaces in the lair turn mirrorlike. Creatures there have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide until Graz’zt uses a different lair action.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Flat stone or metal surfaces within 1 mile of the lair become smooth enough to give mirrorlike reflections.
Wild beasts within 6 miles fight and mate more often, as in their mating season.
A humanoid who spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile of the lair makes a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll on the Madness of Graz’zt table. A success grants 24 hours of immunity to this regional effect.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Graz’zt dies.

gm.title: Madness of Graz’zt
lines:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or within sight of Graz’zt, roll d100. The resulting flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. Obsesses over their reflection and looks down on anyone who fails to admire them.
21–40. Treats sex as the answer to every problem and cannot see why others disagree.
41–60. Craves pleasurable food and other substances and will do anything to get more.
61–80. Passes along rumors without caring if they are true.
81–90. Feels compelled to devise elaborate rites of debauchery to honor Graz’zt.
91–100. Believes that anyone who defies their orders deserves misery.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: AC includes Shadow Armor. Perception 14, Stealth 17. Resists poison damage. Immune to cold damage, Charmed, and Frightened. Darkvision 90 ft. Speaks Sylvan.

gm.title: Ability modifiers
lines: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +6, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha -2

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Fey Resilience. The printed trait grants resistance to Charmed and Unconscious. The stat line grants immunity to Charmed.
Shadow Armor. The mantle gives +3 AC, included in the listed AC, and raises Stealth to 22 in dim light or darkness.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it rolls checks and attacks with disadvantage, loses Shadow Armor, and cannot use Shadow Snare. Existing snares melt.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack. It can replace Claws with Shadow Snare.

Shadow Snare. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d8) cold damage. The target makes a DC 14 Dexterity save or becomes Blinded and Restrained for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to escape. The snare also ends if sunlight reaches the target, the grendelkyn dies or becomes Incapacitated, or it chooses to snare another target.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Shadow Port. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space in dim light or darkness, starting in dim light or darkness. A creature held in Shadow Snare also teleports 30 ft. to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness within 10 ft. of the grendelkyn. If no such space exists, the grendelkyn releases it when teleporting.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Frenzied Shriek. When reduced to 43 HP or fewer, the grendelkyn can shriek. Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened for 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Dog attack or full attack. Bite +7 melee (2d6+3).
Owl attack. Claws +6 melee (1d4+2). Full attack adds bite +4 melee (1d6+2).
Frightful Presence (Ex). It howls or screeches when it first detects evil on its grounds and can repeat the howl at will as a standard action. Evil creatures within 30 ft. make a DC 15 Fear save. A success grants immunity to this grim’s Frightful Presence for one day.
Turning (Su). Turn or destroy evil undead and outsiders as a 9th-level cleric.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
The grim chooses dog or owl form at dusk and retains it until dawn. Most statistics are shared across both forms. It fades in daylight, invisible and intangible, and returns fully healed at sunset. It never leaves its grounds and does not need food or sleep.
Detect Corruption (Su). It continually detects evil undead and outsiders within 60 ft. It has a 20% chance per failed powers check to detect corruption in other creatures.
DR 15/magic and spell resistance 16. Immune to necromantic effects. Magic circle against evil operates continuously at caster level 12th and cannot be suppressed. Sense Motive and Spot get a +4 racial bonus.

gm.title: Fear save
lines: Ravenloft Fear save. Roll against the DC using Will and applicable fear adjustments. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked for 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Another failed Fear save escalates an existing fear effect by one step. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

gm.title: Description
lines: A robed spirit comes to collect a dying creature’s soul. It fights only if someone interferes.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC components +2 Dex and +8 deflection. Base attack +5, grapple +7 as printed. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +6.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. +2 scythe at +9 melee. Use the blade for 2d4 + 5 nonlethal damage and Destruction, or the pole for 1d6 + 5 nonlethal damage and Feign Death.
Destruction (Su). A living creature hit by the blade makes a DC 16 Fortitude save or dies. Only true resurrection or miracle restores a victim slain this way.
Feign Death (Su). The pole forces a DC 16 Will save. Failure leaves the target in a deathlike trance for 5 minutes. Magic can discern life.
Gaze of Fear (Su). As a standard action, target a foe with a DC 16 Fear save. Looking at the reaper by itself does not trigger the effect.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/bludgeoning. Immune to cold, mind-affecting effects, and necromantic effects. Electricity and fire resistance 10. Incorporeal and Mists subtype traits. Only the dying and creatures that see ethereal or invisible beings can see it. Attacking does not end invisibility. Speak with dead can allow communication.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: When a character in Ravenloft is dying, use a 5% appearance chance and add 5 percentage points for each prior brush with death. Reaching −8 HP or dying and returning counts. It alternates scythe and gaze from round to round when opposed. Death ward protects its intended target. Any healing magic used on that target makes the reaper leave. If the reaper is slain, the target stabilizes and regains 10% of maximum HP.

gm.title: Skills and feats

lines: Vox Machina’s half-giant brawler, armed with the Bloodaxe and Titanstone Knuckles.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Strength saves +14, Constitution +12. Animal Handling +6, Athletics +14, Intimidation +7, Survival +6. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common, Dwarvish and Giant, with limited literacy.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Brutal Critical. Roll three extra weapon dice after the usual doubled weapon dice on a critical hit.
Feral Instinct. Roll initiative with Advantage.
Melee Master. He may trade a −5 penalty on a melee attack roll for +10 damage on a hit.
Reckless. At the start of his turn he may take Advantage on his melee weapon attacks that turn. Attacks against him then also have Advantage until his next turn starts.
Relentless Rage. If he drops to 0 HP during his Rage, a DC 10 Constitution save lets him stay at 1 HP.
Spellbreaker. When he damages a creature concentrating on a spell, it makes the save to keep that spell with Disadvantage. He has Advantage on saves against spells cast by creatures within 5 ft.
Toughness. His listed HP include 40 extra points.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Bloodaxe, Dwarven Thrower or Titanstone Knuckles. While raging, add a third melee weapon attack.
Bloodaxe. Melee weapon attack +16, reach 5 ft. Hit for 20 (1d12 + 14) slashing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic. If he drops the target to 0 HP, he gains 10 temporary HP.
Dwarven Thrower. Melee or ranged weapon attack +17, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit for 24 (2d8 + 15) bludgeoning.
Titanstone Knuckles. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 5 ft. Hit for 14 (1d4 + 12) bludgeoning.

He gains the extra melee attack in Multiattack and +4 damage on melee weapon hits. The listed attacks already include that bonus. He gains one level of Exhaustion when the Rage ends.

lines: Rock Catching. When a rock or similar missile is hurled at the gargant, it can catch the missile with a successful DC 10 Dexterity save to prevent the bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: Description
lines: This grung represents a typical hunter or warrior. Grungs can also serve as mercenaries, game wardens, guards, or bandits.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. The grung can breathe both air and water.
Poisonous Skin. A creature that grapples the grung or touches its bare skin must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute. Once out of contact, it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition on a success.
Standing Leap. The grung can jump up to 25 ft. horizontally or 15 ft. vertically, with or without a running start.
Water Dependency. At the end of any day when the grung has spent less than 1 hour immersed in water, it gains one level of exhaustion. It can recover from that exhaustion only through magic or at least 1 hour of immersion.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage and 5 (2d4) poison damage.

gm.title: Optional Grung poison mechanics
lines:
If using this option, choose the grung’s color. A creature poisoned by the grung also suffers that color’s effect for as long as that poisoning lasts.
Blue. The poisoned creature must make a loud noise at the start and end of each of its turns.
Gold. The poisoned creature is charmed by the grung and can speak Grung.
Green. The poisoned creature can move only by climbing or standing jumps. While flying, it cannot take actions or reactions unless it lands.
Orange. The poisoned creature is frightened of its allies.
Purple. The poisoned creature can move or act only to soak itself in liquid or mud or to reach a place where it can do so.
Red. If food is within reach, the poisoned creature must use its action to eat.

gm.title: Description
lines: A guard drake looks like a squat, wingless version of the dragon whose scales created it. It bonds with the first creature to feed it and can learn the same commands as a guard dog.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

gm.title: Chromatic drake mechanics
lines:
Choose the color of the dragon that supplied the scales. Each color adds the movement and defense listed below to the base stat block.
Black. Swim 30 ft. The drake breathes air and water and has acid resistance.
Blue. Burrow 20 ft. The drake has lightning resistance.
Green. Swim 30 ft. The drake breathes air and water and has poison resistance.
Red. Climb 30 ft. The drake has fire resistance.
White. Burrow 20 ft. and climb 30 ft. The drake has cold resistance.

gm.title: Creation and training
lines: A chromatic dragon donates 10 pounds of fresh scales. The ritual also needs a large supply of fresh meat and an iron cauldron. After several days, a Small egg emerges and hatches within a few hours. A hatchling bonds to its first feeder. It reaches full size and can finish training in two to three weeks. Guard drakes cannot reproduce, and their scales cannot make another drake.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Wizards of the Coast, Keep on the Shadowfell (2009 revision), pp. 20, 32. Encounter A4, Burial Site, and Area 3, Excavation Site.

gm.title: Printed ability modifiers
lines: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +5, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha +2.

gm.title: Printed powers
lines: Bite. Melee basic, standard, at-will. +6 vs. AC. Hit for 1d10 + 3 damage, or 1d10 + 9 while the drake is within 2 squares of an ally.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Immune to fear while within 2 squares of an ally.

gm.title: Encounter A4 checks
lines: Agrid orders the two drakes to charge the most formidable-looking PC. An Insight check opposed by Agrid’s Bluff can expose his deception, which prompts the order to attack. Climbing the steep slope requires DC 15 Athletics and goes at half speed.

gm.title: Area 3 checks
lines:
DC 15 Perception finds the secret door that leads to Area 4. DC 10 Perception hears goblin voices, and a Goblin speaker can make DC 15 Perception to understand the argument. The two drakes help keep adventurers down in the excavation. A drop from a plank or ledge is 10 ft., deals 1d10 damage and leaves the creature prone. The earth wall requires DC 15 Athletics. On each attempt it crumbles on 1–10 on a d20, sliding the climber to the floor and leaving them prone in their starting square without damage.
A Medium creature crossing a plank needs DC 15 Acrobatics. Heavy armor breaks the plank. A PC or goblin can push an unoccupied plank as a minor action. An occupied plank requires a DC 14 Strength check for a Small occupant or DC 17 for a Medium occupant. Rocking a plank takes a standard action and a Strength check against the occupant’s Reflex. Success drops the occupant into the excavation. Ladders take 4 squares of movement to climb 10 ft. A PC or goblin can topple one as a standard action and use a standard action with DC 10 Strength to reposition it. Guard drakes use the ramp and cannot manipulate planks or ladders.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Blight Seeds. At the end of a Long Rest, the blight expels 1d6 seeds into unoccupied ground spaces within 30 ft. After 24 hours, each seed becomes a creature under its control. Roll 1d8 for each seed. On 1–4 it becomes a Twig Blight, on 5–6 a Needle Blight, and on 7–8 a Vine Blight.

lines:

Thorn Volley. Ranged attack, +12 to hit, range 60/180 ft. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) Piercing damage.
Life-Draining Root. Choose one Huge or smaller creature the blight can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 20 Constitution save, the creature takes 14 (2d6 + 7) Necrotic damage and is Grappled by one of the blight's six roots (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the creature is Restrained and takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature's Hit Point maximum decreases by the Necrotic damage it takes from this action, and the blight regains that many Hit Points.

lines:

lines: The sphinx can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The sphinx regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn. Claw Attack. The sphinx makes one claw attack. Teleport (Costs 2 Actions). The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Cast a Spell (Costs 3 Actions). The sphinx casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

gm.title: Description
lines: A sphinx that guards divine knowledge with riddles and may trade what she knows for treasure or service.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Inscrutable. Effects cannot read the sphinx's thoughts or sense its emotions. It can refuse any divination spell and is immune to that spell if it does. Wisdom (Insight) checks to judge its intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Divine Vigil. The sphinx needs neither sleep nor food while it keeps watch.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The sphinx has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at the end of another creature's turn. It can pass, and it cannot act while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to take actions. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using these options.
Claw Attack. Make one Claw attack.
Teleport (2 actions). Magically teleport up to 120 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. Worn and carried equipment goes along.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast one of its prepared spells and spend a spell slot as usual.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one magical effect. Each option is available once per short or long rest. The sphinx cannot use its lair actions while outside its lair, Incapacitated, or otherwise unable to take actions. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using an option.
Reroll initiative. Every creature in the lair rolls initiative again. The sphinx may keep its current roll.
Change age. Each creature in the lair makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it ages or grows younger by 1d20 years, as the sphinx chooses. No creature becomes younger than 1 year old. Greater Restoration can return a creature to its normal age.
Shift time. Move everything in the lair up to 10 years ahead or back, as the sphinx chooses. The sphinx alone notices the change immediately. Wish can restore its caster and up to seven creatures the caster designates to their normal time.
Shift planes. Move the sphinx and up to seven other creatures it can see in the lair to another plane. On its turn, the sphinx can return to its lair as a bonus action and take up to seven creatures with it.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
9th-level wizard. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 16 and +8 to hit. It requires no material components.
Cantrips, at will. Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make four Tentacle attacks. One can be replaced with Bite.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Swallow. A Large or smaller creature that the hafgufa is Grappling within 5 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. On a failure it is swallowed and the Grapple ends. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against outside attacks and effects, and takes 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the hafgufa’s turns. Capacity six. If a creature inside deals at least 40 damage in a single turn, the hafgufa makes a DC 19 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it expels everyone inside, each falling Prone within 10 ft. When the hafgufa dies, the restraint ends and a swallowed creature can spend 20 ft. of movement to exit Prone.

gm.title: Half-dragon template
lines:
Start with a beast, humanoid, giant, or monstrosity. Keep its statistics except for the template changes. Give it blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and Draconic in addition to its languages.
Color determines resistance. Black and copper resist acid. Blue and bronze resist lightning. Brass, gold, and red resist fire. Green resists poison. Silver and white resist cold.
Give the creature its dragon color's breath weapon. Use a wyrmling's breath for Large or smaller, a young dragon's for Huge, and an adult dragon's for Gargantuan. The minimum starting CRs to use this template without recalculating CR are 2, 7, and 8 for those size categories, respectively. If the base creature falls below that threshold, recalculate its CR using the Dungeon Master's Guide.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Choose slam +4 melee (1d4 and 1d4 Strength damage plus 1d4 Dexterity damage to a living target), or +1 dagger +13 melee or ranged (1d4, 19–20/×2). Sneak attack adds 3d6 when applicable.
Fatigue Aura (Su). A living creature coming within 60 ft. makes a DC 14 Will save. Failure fatigues it for 1d6 rounds, or exhausts it for that duration if already fatigued.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living target in a grapple. Each round the pin holds, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP.
Spell-like abilities. At will purify food and water, 3/day create food and water, caster level 12. At will as a standard action it can despoil 12 cubic ft. of food and water. The Despoil text gives save DC 10 + Charisma modifier (12 here), while the sample gives DC 12 + spell level for spell-like abilities.
Children of the Night (Su, 1/day). Standard action to call 4d8 dogs or 4d10 cats. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and serve up to 1 hour.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Cold and electricity resistance 20, turn resistance +4, undead traits, evasion and uncanny dodge. Padfoot makes its movement silent. Gaseous form smells like pipe tobacco, gives fly 20 ft. (perfect), and can be maintained indefinitely. Alternate Form can assume a boar, dog, riding dog, or owl. As a standard action assume the listed animal form. Lose the slam and domination, gain the animal’s natural weapons and extraordinary attacks, and retain this form until the next sunrise or another change. Fast healing is 3 when the moon is less than half full, 4 at half or gibbous, and 5 on the three nights of the full moon. At 0 HP it takes gaseous form and retreats to its coffin. It is destroyed if it cannot reach the coffin within 2 hours. At the coffin it remains helpless for 1 hour, reaches 1 HP, and then resumes fast healing.

gm.title: Spawn
lines: A halfling slain by Constitution drain becomes spawn at 4 HD or fewer and a halfling vampire at 5 HD or more. Both remain controlled until their creator dies. Halfling spawn are Small with +1 size to attack and AC and retain DC 14 Fatigue Aura. Their slam deals just 1d4 Strength damage as its special rider. Blood Drain, gaseous form and fast healing use ordinary spawn rules.

gm.title: Repelling and slaying
lines: Heavy tobacco smoke other than its own gaseous form repels it. So does a clearly presented holy symbol. A hearth fire bars it from the room and an upright horseshoe over a doorway or window bars passage. It can rest only within 1 mile of its original grave. Sunlight leaves one chance to escape before destruction next round. Running water costs one-third of HP each round and destroys it after 3 rounds of immersion. Rain deals 1d6 acid per round, a thunderstorm 1d8 and a hurricane 1d10. At 0 HP or less from rain it is destroyed. Only a still-burning wooden stake fresh from a hearth kills it while left in place. The book gives permanent destruction if its severed hands and feet burn in a hearth for three hours.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Balance +15, Bluff +18, Climb +10, Disable Device +11, Disguise +10, Forgery +11, Hide +23, Jump +10, Listen +14, Move Silently +17, Open Lock +15, Search +11, Sense Motive +10, Spot +12, Tumble +15. Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Shield Proficiency, Weapon Finesse.

gm.title: Encounter adaptation
lines: Apply the strain to the 3.5 vampire template. Retain unmodified abilities, size, BAB, saves and skill points. The base vampire uses undead d12 Hit Dice and has no Constitution score. Keep an existing swim speed and ignore vulnerability to immersion in running water if the base creature can swim. Use save DC 10 + half HD rounded down + Charisma modifier unless specified. Age rows replace one another. Apply only to a halfling. Fast healing numbers correspond to less than half, half or gibbous, and the three nights of the full moon.

Eminent. Abilities 4/10/6/8/10. Speed +20 ft., natural AC +8, turn resistance +7, CR +3. Fast healing 5/6/8.
Patriarch. Abilities 6/12/8/10/12. Speed +30 ft., natural AC +8, turn resistance +8, CR +4. Fast healing 6/8/10.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: Description
lines: A spiderlike head can puppet a corpse or call for help from behind a web of nearly invisible blades.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +2. AC 14 (+2 size, +2 Dex). Base attack +1, grapple −7. Space and reach 2½ ft. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +3. Bluff +5, Disguise +6, Hide +11, Listen +7, Move Silently +9, Spot +2. Weapon Finesse. Any land or underground. Solitary. No treasure. Always neutral evil.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Bite +4 melee (1d6−2 plus poison), or slam +0 melee (1d3) in a host body.
Poison (Ex). The bite carries poison. Up to 3/day the head hunter can also spit contact venom at a target within 15 ft. with a ranged touch attack. Fortitude DC 13, initial and secondary damage 2d4 Constitution.
Razor Web (Ex). Spinning takes full-round actions, at a rate of one 5-ft. cube per minute and at most two cubes per day. Spot DC 20 notices a web. Each web square a creature crosses attacks at +10 melee for 2d6 damage. On a critical hit, roll 1d10. On 1–9 a random limb is severed, adding nonlethal damage equal to the normal damage and bleeding as from a wounding weapon. On 10 it cuts off the target’s head as a vorpal weapon would. Each web square has AC 8 and 10 HP.

gm.title: Host body (Ex)
lines: It can spend one minute implanting itself in a corpse killed in its web and feed on it for ten days. It can puppet a Small to Large corpse. The printed Medium host has 1d10 HD (5 HP), AC 12, Str 10, Dex 10, Ref +0, Hide +2, Move Silently +4, and 5-ft. space and reach. Hits damage the host unless an attacker specifically targets the head. When the host is destroyed, the head hunter falls as if dead. Left unattended it crawls out and seeks another corpse. Entering a new host restores its own HP.

gm.title: Traits and tactics
lines: Immune to poison and webbing. It climbs any webs freely, including its own razor web. It and its web take double fire damage, and fire damage spreads to every square in the web. Tremorsense 60 ft. detects anything touching the ground or its webs. It is effectively blinded to targets beyond 20 ft. that evade tremorsense. Seeing it without a host or on a quadruped calls for a DC 13 Ravenloft Horror save (Will). Speaks Elven, Drow, and several domain languages. Racial +5 on Bluff, Disguise, Hide, Listen, and Move Silently.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed host AC is 12 with a listed +2 Dex component, though the host’s bracketed Dexterity is 10. Use the listed total. The text gives the web’s critical result as 1–10 without naming the die, so use 1d10. The spit has no printed attack bonus. Use +5 ranged touch for the unhosted form from its listed base attack, Dexterity, and size.

gm.title: Description
lines: A hearth fiend lives inside a stubborn flame. It whispers bargains from the fire and tries to get a servant to build it a bigger one.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any land or underground, inside an open fire. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. No treasure. Advancement 3–5 HD (Medium), 6–9 HD (Large), or 10–18 HD (Huge). No level adjustment listed. Speaks Ignan and can communicate with any creature that has a language.

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +5 as printed. AC 15 (+1 size, +1 Dex as printed, +3 natural). Touch AC 12 and flat-footed AC 14 use those listed bonuses. Base attack +1, grapple −3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +4, Will +0.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Damage reduction 10/magic, elemental traits, Fire and Mists subtypes, and immunity to electricity. Normally invisible, visible at will, and detectable with see invisibility. The fire it occupies stays lit until it is slain or driven out. Water Vulnerability (Ex). Magically created water deals 1d4 damage per gallon.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Fire bolt +3 ranged (1d6 damage, ignites flammables) or slam (1d4 plus 1d4 fire). Use +2 melee for the slam as a table default.
Burn (Su). A fire bolt reaches 10 ft. per HD (20 ft. for this fiend). A creature hit must make a DC 14 Reflex save or catch fire for 1d4 rounds. Use the 3.5 catching-on-fire procedure.
Transfer Flame. As a standard action, transfer to another open flame within 5 ft.
Fire Charm (Su). Someone near the flame must succeed on a DC 15 Listen check to make out its whispers, then make a DC 14 Will save or be affected as by charm person (caster level 8th). The fiend can charm only one creature at a time. It may keep trying until the target gives in or leaves.

gm.title: Arrival
lines: Casting a fire-based spell in Ravenloft has a 1% chance per spell level to draw a hearth fiend into the nearest open flame.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed initiative and Dex contribution to AC do not follow the listed Dex 16 and Improved Initiative. Use the printed totals. The slam has no printed attack bonus. The table default uses +1 base attack, +1 size, and +0 Str.

gm.title: Combat statistics

gm.title: Traits
lines: Immunities (Su). Immune to poisons and to the gaze attacks of reptilian creatures, including other hebi-no-onna. Snake Control (Su). Any snake that can hear its commands obeys, even at the cost of its life. This does not summon snakes. A lair often holds 20–40, many of them vipers.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. One snake-arm bite +14 melee (1d3 plus poison) or one human-mouth bite +9 melee (1d2 plus poison). Full attack. Two snake-arm bites +14 each, or one human-mouth bite +9.
Snake-arm poison (Ex). DC 15 Fortitude. Initial and secondary damage 1d6 Constitution each.
Daigatu (Ex, 3/day). On a human-mouth bite, DC 20 Fortitude. Initial and secondary effects each cause hallucinations and stun for 1d10 + 2 rounds. Before reaching maturity at about 12, a daughter’s bite instead deals 1d2 − 1. Her venom nauseates the target for 2d4 rounds on a failed DC 13 Fortitude save.
Hypnotic Gaze (Su). Choose a target as a standard action. DC 20 Will or hypnotism at caster level 14th. Merely looking at the hebi-no-onna does not trigger the effect.

gm.title: Spells
lines: Casts as a 14th-level wizard specializing in Enchantment. Save DC 14 + spell level. Only material components with a listed gp cost are required. Preferred spells include charm monster, charm person, confusion, dominate monster, dominate person, feeblemind, geas, globe of invulnerability, hold monster, hold person, lesser globe of invulnerability, ray of enfeeblement, suggestion, and greater teleport.

gm.title: Tactics
lines: Use servants to hold foes back while casting or using the gaze from behind a lesser globe of invulnerability. Use greater teleport to flee if gravely threatened.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The summary lists gaze immunity broadly. The detailed rule limits it to reptilian sources. The preferred spell list contains dominate monster but the creature casts as a 14th-level wizard. Use the native wizard slot limits and leave that 9th-level spell unprepared in this encounter. The spell list is a set of preferences rather than a prepared loadout.

gm.title: Description
lines: Devil commanders hold these magical siege machines in reserve against invading demons and mortals. A loose engine can rampage on its own.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold and psychic. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change the engine's shape.
Magic Resistance. The engine has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The engine needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Flesh-Crushing Stride. Move in a straight line up to the engine's speed. The engine can enter spaces occupied by creatures of Large size or smaller. Each creature whose space it enters makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a success, push it to the nearest space outside the engine's path. On a failure, it falls prone and takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage.
If the engine stays in the prone creature's space, the creature is restrained while they share the space. The restrained creature or another creature within 5 ft. of it can make a DC 18 Strength check. On a success, the restrained creature moves to an unoccupied space it chooses within 5 ft. of the engine, ending the restraint.
Hellfire Weapons. Choose a weapon or roll a d6. On 1–2 use Bonemelt Sprayer, on 3–4 use Lightning Flail, and on 5–6 use Thunder Cannon.
Bonemelt Sprayer. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) fire damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage. On a success, halve both. On a failure, the fuel coats the target and deals 5 (1d10) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage at the end of each of its turns. The target or another creature within 5 ft. of it can use an action to scrape off the fuel.
Lightning Flail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) lightning damage. Choose up to three other creatures the engine can see within 30 ft. of the target. Each makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 22 (5d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Thunder Cannon. Choose a point the engine can see within 120 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. of the point makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) thunder damage. On a success, halve both.
Soul of a slain creature. If the chosen weapon option kills a creature, its soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus after 1d4 hours. If it remains dead when the lemure rises, restoring it requires Wish or killing the lemure and then casting True Resurrection on the creature's original body. Constructs and devils are immune to this soul effect.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 152.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dead hero takes a living host to finish a deed or disgrace the villain who stopped it.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Very rare, solitary. Retains its alignment from life. Fearless morale 20. No magic resistance, treasure, Legacies or cinnabryl requirement.

gm.title: Actions
lines: The spirit has no direct attack. When the host faces deadly peril, it awakens and automatically influences the host with suggestion to rush into battle. Use the effects of a potion of super-heroism regardless of the host’s class. The host must fight with conspicuous daring for one round per foe, with a minimum of 4 and a maximum of 15 rounds. Afterward the host chooses whether to keep fighting or withdraw with flair.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Outside combat the spirit mostly lies dormant and communicates through empathy alone. Its host keeps free will under ordinary conditions. A host who adopts the spirit’s flamboyant habits may gain Luck and reroll a failed saving throw or ability check. That benefit can persist while the spirit is dormant. It leaves after fulfilling its goal or moves on if the host gains a level first or dies.

gm.title: Exorcism and rivalry
lines: The spirit cannot be attacked or turned directly, but exorcism can drive it out. A good spirit leaves if a host sincerely asks. It never chooses a host already carrying a Legacy Leech. Both spirits recognize one another when their hosts meet. If the spirit’s host refuses to attack the leech’s host, it attempts to seize control with magic jar, potentially forcing a fight to the death.

gm.title: Experience
lines: Award the host 450 XP once, upon the spirit’s first activation. Helping it finish its deed earns a further 1,000 XP.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: pp. 100–101, with Luck Legacy on p. 8

gm.title: Super-heroism
lines: Use the host’s current level. Level 0: +6 effective combat levels and 5d10 bonus HP. Levels 1–3: +5 and 4d10 + 1. Levels 4–6: +4 and 3d10 + 2. Levels 7–9: +3 and 2d10 + 3. Levels 10–12: +2 and 1d10 + 4. A host of level 13 or higher gains no bonus. Deduct damage from the bonus HP first. The spirit’s encounter rules determine duration and allow any class. See Encyclopedia Magica, Volume III, p. 890.

gm.title: Description
lines: The elven High Mage hides their lichdom. Their soulstone is a sphere of everlasting ice.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +11, Int +14, Wis +13, Cha +13. Arcana +14, Athletics +10, Deception +13, History +14, Perception +13, Persuasion +13. Resists fire and cold and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 23. Speaks Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, and Sylvan. Telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Draining Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. Vairae then has disadvantage on spell attacks until the end of their next turn.
Rejuvenation (as the Lich). If destroyed with the soulstone intact, Vairae's soul enters it. A creature that can see the stone at the start of its turn makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it is Charmed until the end of its next turn and must try to move toward and touch the stone, avoiding clear hazards. Touching the occupied stone forces a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature drops to 0 HP and Vairae reforms at full HP. On a success, the creature loses half its HP and Vairae reforms at half HP. In either case Vairae appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the stone. The stone has AC 19, 50 HP, and immunity to every damage type except force and thunder.
Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
Turn Immunity. Vairae is immune to effects that turn Undead.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Glare of Undeath and make four attacks in any combination of Conflagration, Immortal Pain, and Magic Drain.
Conflagration (4th-level spell). Ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 150-ft. range, one target. Hit 35 (10d6) fire damage. If the target takes both an action and a bonus action on its next turn, it takes 17 (5d6) more fire damage at the end of that turn.
Immortal Pain (4th-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 90-ft. range, one creature. Hit 28 (8d6) psychic damage and afflicts the target with pain, halving the damage its attacks deal. After each attack it makes against an enemy, the target can end the effect with a successful DC 22 Constitution save. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect also ends the pain.
Magic Drain (4th-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 60-ft. range, one creature. Hit 26 (4d12) necrotic damage. If the target is under the effects of spells Vairae did not cast, those effects end on a failed DC 22 Wisdom save.
Glare of Undeath. One creature Vairae sees within 60 ft. makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure, it clutches itself and is Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn. A creature the target can hear and understand can use an action to end the effect with a DC 22 Charisma (Persuasion) check.
Machinations of Bone (2/day). Choose a visible point within 150 ft. Every enemy within 30 ft. of that point makes a DC 22 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 54 (12d8) piercing damage, falls Prone, and cannot stand until it receives supernatural healing.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Necrotic Form (3rd-level spell). Assume a shadow form and move up to their speed. Until the end of the turn, Vairae is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and to Grappled and Restrained, and can pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Baleful Teleport (6th-level spell). When a visible creature within 120 ft. targets Vairae with an attack, the attacker makes a DC 22 Charisma save. On a failure, Vairae teleports the attacker up to 60 ft. into a visible unoccupied space. If Vairae is now an invalid target, the attacker must choose a new target or miss.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Cages of Wasting. Enemies within 60 ft. make DC 22 Dexterity saves. Failure deals 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and Restrains the target in a cage for up to 1 minute. A success halves the damage. A trapped target can repeat the save at the end of each turn or teleport out. Destroying Vairae also ends the restraint.
2. My Magic Alone. Creatures within 60 ft. make DC 22 Wisdom saves. A creature that fails cannot benefit from magic items or cast spells of 4th level or higher until the end of Vairae's next turn.
3. Necrostorm. Creatures within 60 ft. make DC 22 Dexterity saves, taking 78 (12d12) necrotic damage or half on a success. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises as a wraith at the start of Vairae's next turn, permanently following Vairae's verbal commands.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
On initiative 20, losing ties, use one effect. The same lair action cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Soul Sip. Choose two visible enemies within 90 ft. Each takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage on a failed DC 20 Constitution save.
Spirit Shell. Until the end of initiative count 20 of the next round, a creature hitting Vairae with a melee attack makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is Dazed until the start of that creature's next turn.
Unnatural Born Leader. One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed and make a weapon attack against a creature Vairae chooses.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.

gm.title: Mundane Attacks (MCDM)
lines: A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

lines: Undead. Lair actions, p. 258. Stat block, p. 260.

lines: Machinations of Bone involves body horror. Spectral blades can describe the same effect at the table.

gm.title: Soulstone Ward
lines: One Last Horror. A 9th-level Glyph of Warding guards the soulstone. It triggers when a creature succeeds on the DC 20 Constitution save after touching the occupied stone, or when a creature other than Vairae touches the empty stone. The glyph casts True Polymorph on that creature. On a failed DC 22 Wisdom save, it turns the target into a camel.

gm.title: Winter Throne
lines:
Vairae fights until destroyed while the soulstone remains intact. If it has been destroyed, Vairae tries to flee the tower upon reaching 100 HP.
Frozen Pool. The pool is difficult terrain. When a creature other than Vairae first touches it on a turn or starts a turn touching it, that creature makes a DC 22 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage and falls Prone. The ice has AC 21 and 100 HP and is immune to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. A 9th-level Dispel Magic ends the magic and melts the ice. A lower-level casting requires a DC 19 spellcasting ability check.
Hallow. The chamber permits Fiends and Undead to enter. Other creatures entering can become vulnerable to necrotic damage under the spell’s Energy Vulnerability effect, with a DC 22 Charisma save.

gm.title: Description
lines: Hill giant rune workers hang rocks from their armor on ropes or chains. Their control of earth and stone often earns them leadership of a band.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Hill Rune. While the giant wears or holds the rock or other object that bears its rune, it can use Stone Avalanche and Hill Rebuff. The object has AC 15 and 20 HP, is immune to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage, and regains all HP at the end of every turn. It turns to dust when it drops to 0 HP or the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe another on an object it possesses when it finishes a short or long rest.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The giant can choose to succeed on a saving throw it fails.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Greatclub attack and use Stone Bolas.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.
Stone Bolas. Throw three stones linked by magical force at a visible creature within 60 ft. It makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained until the start of the giant’s next turn and the stones erupt, dealing 14 (4d6) thunder damage to the target and each creature within 10 ft. of it. On a success, the stones vanish without erupting.
Stone Avalanche (requires Hill Rune). Conjure rocks in a 20-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high cylinder centered on a visible point on the ground within 120 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. On a success, it takes half damage. The rocks make the ground in the area difficult terrain until the start of the giant’s next turn, when they vanish.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 16). At will: Druidcraft, Guidance. 1/day each: Stone Shape, Wall of Stone.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Hill Rebuff (requires Hill Rune). Immediately after a visible creature within 10 ft. damages the giant, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) force damage and be pushed 10 ft. horizontally away from the giant.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines: This giant shapechanger poses as a pile of treasure. Some dragons use one as a decoy. A cornered hoard mimic may trade the real hoard's location for its life.

lines: False Appearance (hoard form only). If motionless when combat starts, the mimic has advantage on initiative. A creature that has never seen it move or act must pass a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize that it is animate.

lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Pseudopod attacks.

Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and the mimic sticks to the target. A creature it sticks to is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. Ability checks to escape have disadvantage.
Caustic Mist (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 27 (6d8) acid damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. A success halves the damage and prevents blindness.
Shapechanger. Change into a treasure hoard or return to the mimic's amorphous form. Its statistics and equipment stay the same. It reverts to its true form on death.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A red-skinned hobgoblin in layered hide and bronze, carrying a brazier-topped standard and a worn round shield.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Hide armor. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Common, Goblin, Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Infernal Ichor. A creature within 5 ft. that reduces the brandbearer to 0 HP takes 1 fire damage.
Too Hot to Handle. When an enemy takes fire damage from a non-minion creature, it takes an extra 1 fire damage for each brandbearer within 5 ft. of it.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the brandbearer to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 12 damage. The brandbearer ignores smaller amounts from those effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Searing Grasp (Group Attack). Melee spell attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 fire damage. On a hit by at least three brandbearers, the target also has disadvantage on saves against fire-damaging spells, powers, and other supernatural effects until the start of the brandbearers’ next turn.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five brandbearers on the same turn can each spend an action to use Searing Grasp on a target within reach of all of them. Roll once at +5 plus the number of participants. A hit deals 4 fire damage per participant. A lone brandbearer uses +5. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. Use separate rolls for groups with different cover or concealment. The target picks which brandbearer receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If an enemy provokes at the same time from multiple brandbearers, each can spend its reaction to join a Searing Grasp attack. Brandbearers have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the first brandbearer’s 12 HP maximum drops one eligible additional brandbearer to 0 HP per 12 surplus damage or part thereof. For melee, eligible brandbearers are within the weapon’s reach. At range, they lie on the line from the attacker through the first target, within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use behind a shield line beside a War Mage or another non-minion ally with fire attacks. A group can set up a tougher fire save, then the caster can follow while the brandbearers keep close to the enemy.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A tusked and horned field commander in dark plate with a purple cloak, a worn shield and a violet-edged sword.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Plate and shield. Saves Con +6, Wis +4. Athletics +7, History +5, Intimidation +5, Perception +4. Fire resistance. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Common, Goblin, Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Battle Ready. While the captain is not Incapacitated, the captain and allies within 60 ft. that can hear them have advantage on initiative rolls and cannot be Surprised.
Infernal Ichor. When this hobgoblin dies, every creature within 5 ft. takes 5 fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Blightblade attacks or two Eye Fire attacks. The captain can replace one attack with On My Mark.
Blightblade. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Eye Fire. Ranged spell attack +6, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) fire damage.
On My Mark. One ally within 60 ft. that can hear the captain can make a weapon attack without spending an action. A hit deals an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Lead the Charge (1/day). The captain and allies within 30 ft. that can see the captain can each move up to their own speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Hidden Gift (3/day). When an ally the captain can see within 30 ft. takes damage, the captain magically turns that ally Invisible. The effect lasts until the end of the ally’s next turn. It ends early if the ally attacks, deals damage, or forces another creature to make a saving throw.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use as a raiding-party commander or a fortification officer. The captain can reposition the squad, call for an attack at the right moment, or help an injured ally withdraw.

lines: Studded leather. Save Dex +6. Acrobatics +6. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Common, Goblin, Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fiery Leap. The firerunner can long jump up to 30 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft., with or without a running start. The first time it lands after a jump on its turn, each creature within 5 ft. takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.
Infernal Ichor. When the firerunner dies, each creature within 5 ft. takes 5 fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Fire Scimitar attacks.
Fire Scimitar. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Blaze Sprint (Recharge 5–6). Move up to the firerunner’s speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature the firerunner comes within 5 ft. of during that move makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) fire damage. Success halves the damage.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use as a camp outrider or a skirmisher in broken terrain. On a clear route it can sprint past several opponents, then use gaps or ledges to spread the party out.

lines: Studded leather. Perception +5. Fire resistance. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common, Goblin, Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Infernal Ichor. When the incendiarist dies, each creature within 5 ft. takes 3 fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

Blazing Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit catches fire and takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns. It, or another creature that can reach it, can use an action to put out the flames. A hit against an already burning creature deals the normal piercing damage without adding a second burning effect.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Unarmored Defense. Add the hobgoblin's Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and wields no shield.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make four attacks in any combination of Unarmed Strike and Dart. The hobgoblin can use Shadow Jaunt once before or after any one of those attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Shadow Jaunt. The hobgoblin magically teleports up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, taking worn and carried equipment with it. Its starting space and destination must both be in dim light or darkness.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The hobgoblin casts as a 2nd-level wizard using Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, True Strike.
Level 1 (3 slots). Charm Person, Disguise Self, Expeditious Retreat, Silent Image.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A young hobgoblin in plain leather with a cloth headband, a wooden shield and a longsword.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Leather armor and shield. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Common, Goblin, Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Infernal Ichor. A creature within 5 ft. that reduces the recruit to 0 HP takes 1 fire damage.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the recruit to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 7 damage. The recruit ignores smaller amounts from those effects.
Tactical Positioning. When a non-minion ally attacks a creature, the ally adds +1 to the attack roll for each recruit within 5 ft. of the target, to a maximum of +5.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Longsword (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 slashing damage.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five recruits on the same turn can each spend an action to attack one target within reach of all of them. Roll once at +4 plus the number of participants. A hit deals 1 slashing damage per participant. A lone recruit uses +4. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. Roll separately for groups facing different cover or concealment. The target picks which recruit receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If an enemy provokes at the same time from multiple recruits, they can each spend a reaction to join a Longsword attack. Recruits have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the first recruit’s 7 HP maximum drops one eligible additional recruit to 0 HP for each 7 points of surplus or part thereof. For melee, eligible recruits are within reach of the weapon. At range, they lie on the line from the attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use as training-yard guards or a junior shield line. Recruit placement helps an officer’s attacks and gives the party a reason to break up the formation.

gm.title: Statistics
lines: Speed · 30 ft., fly 30 ft. in smoke form

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A dark red, horned hobgoblin with a battered shield and curls of gray smoke drifting from its armor.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather and shield. Stealth +5. Fire resistance. In smoke form, resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks and is immune to Grappled and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Common, Goblin, Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amorphous (Smoke Form Only). The smokebinder can move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Infernal Ichor. When the smokebinder dies, each creature within 5 ft. takes 3 fire damage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Toxic Flame. Melee spell attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage. With advantage on the attack, a hit also leaves the target Poisoned and unable to speak until the end of its next turn.
Choking Bolt. Ranged spell attack +5, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d8) fire damage. With advantage on the attack, a hit also leaves the target unable to speak until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Smoke Form (1/day). Transform into magical gray smoke for 1 minute, including worn and carried gear. Gain a flying speed equal to walking speed, resistance to mundane bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks, and immunity to Grappled and Restrained. Revert as a bonus action or immediately upon becoming Incapacitated or dying.
Sneak (Smoke Form Only). Take the Hide action.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use as an infiltrator who passes through a narrow gap, hides, and strikes from ambush. It can switch back to physical form as needed.

lines: Plate and shield. Darkvision 60 ft. Common, Goblin.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Martial Advantage. Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage to a creature if the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin who is not Incapacitated.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three melee attacks or two ranged javelin attacks.

Leadership (recharges after a short or long rest). For 1 minute, when a nonhostile creature the hobgoblin can see within 30 ft. rolls an attack or saving throw, the hobgoblin can call out and let that creature add 1d4 if it can hear and understand the command. A creature can use only one Leadership die per roll. The effect ends if the hobgoblin is Incapacitated.
