gm.title: Description
lines: A metallic dragon can bind radiant energy into its empty hide to keep an oath or guard an artifact after death. Its scattered body can reassemble around its head.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Reconstruction. At 0 HP the dragon breaks into nine pieces: two arms, two legs, two wings, a tail, a torso, and a head. Each is a Large object with AC 19, 27 HP, and immunity to psychic and poison damage. After 1d6 days, if all pieces remain within 6 miles of one another, they teleport to the head and merge. The dragon returns to full HP and becomes active again.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks. The dragon can also use Sapping Presence.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Sapping Presence. Each creature the dragon chooses within 60 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure its speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attacks until the end of its next turn. A success grants immunity to this dragon's Sapping Presence for 24 hours.
Radiant Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Dexterity save, taking 54 (12d8) radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The dragon can spend up to 3 legendary actions, using one option at the end of another creature's turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Ghostly Binding (2 actions). A creature the dragon can see within 60 ft. must pass a DC 19 Strength save or be restrained until the end of the dragon's next turn.
Booming Scales (3 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) thunder damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A young mage with windswept hair, maroon studded leather, a blue cloak and an open spellbook.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather. Arcana +5. Passive Perception 10. Common plus any two languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Empower Patron. The mage chooses a non-minion patron. At the start of the patron’s turn, count the apprentice mages who chose that patron, are within 60 ft. of them, and can see them. The patron gains 2 temporary HP for each of those mages.
Exploit Weakness. An attack made with advantage deals 1 extra damage per apprentice making or joining it.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the mage to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 13 damage. The mage ignores smaller amounts from those effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Lightning Strike (Group Attack). Ranged spell attack +5, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit 2 lightning damage. Exploit Weakness adds no extra damage to these secondary effects.

lines: A bald, broad-shouldered fighter with scarred forearms, studded leather and a fur collar.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Studded leather. Athletics +5, Intimidation +3. Passive Perception 10. Common.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Exploit Opening (3/day). When this creature makes an attack, it can give itself advantage on that attack roll.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Grab and Haymaker.
Grab. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). The brawler cannot use Grab on another creature until this grapple ends.
Haymaker. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (3d4 + 3) against a Grappled target.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Meat Shield. When a visible creature hits the brawler with a ranged attack while the brawler is grappling someone else, the brawler gains +2 AC against that attack. If the bonus turns the hit into a miss, the attack hits the Grappled creature instead.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use as a tavern enforcer, pit fighter, or gang lieutenant. Grab and Haymaker work together on one turn. Throw gives the brawler a way to clear a doorway or send someone into an obstacle.

lines:

gm.title: Actions
lines:

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five acolytes on the same turn can each spend an action to use the same attack against a target all can reach or attack at range. Roll once at +4 plus the number of acolytes. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use as crypt attendants or a cult leader’s escort. Three or more acolytes can keep Death Chant active. Players can break the formation to protect a fallen ally.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A white-haired weather mage in indigo robes, carrying a copper-tipped staff that crackles with blue lightning.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: AC 15 with Mage Armor. Saves Int +7, Wis +5. Arcana +7, History +7. Passive Perception 12. Common plus any two languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Exploit Opening (3/day). When this creature makes an attack, it can give itself advantage on that attack roll.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Arcane Staff. Melee or ranged spell attack +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit 21 (6d6) lightning damage.
Gust of Wind (1/day, 2nd-level spell, concentration). For up to 1 minute, wind extends from the wizard in a line 60 ft. long and 10 ft. wide. A creature starting its turn in the line must pass a DC 15 Strength save or be pushed 15 ft. away. Each foot of movement toward the wizard in the line costs 2 ft. The wind disperses vapor and gas, snuffs unprotected flames, and has a 50 percent chance to snuff protected flames.
Lightning Bolt (3/day, 3rd-level spell). Each creature in a line 100 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable objects in the line ignite if they are neither worn nor carried.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: While concentrating on Gust of Wind, the wizard can aim the line in a different direction.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Arcane Shield (3/day). When an attack hits the wizard, the wizard gains +5 AC against that attack, which may turn it into a miss. An attacker within 10 ft. also makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage and is pushed 10 ft. away.

gm.title: Utility Spells
lines: Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 15). At will: Mage Hand and Prestidigitation. Once per day each: Clairvoyance (10-minute casting time), Mage Armor, See Invisibility, and Sending. All other spells in this list use one action.

gm.title: Elementalist variants
lines:
Human Cryomancer. Change Arcane Staff and Arcane Shield to cold damage and replace Lightning Bolt with Ice Storm.
Human Pyromancer. Change Arcane Staff and Arcane Shield to fire damage, replace Gust of Wind with Flaming Sphere, and replace Lightning Bolt with Fireball.

gm.title: Encounter uses
lines: Use as a harbor mage, rival researcher, or guild defender. Gust of Wind can hold a narrow approach. Allied guards can protect the wizard while it lines up a Lightning Bolt.

gm.title: Description
lines: A duke of Cania and loyal servant of Mephistopheles. Hutijin commands two companies of pit fiends and resents mortal conjurers who call him away from his post.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Infernal Despair. Every creature other than a devil has disadvantage on saving throws while within 30 ft. of Hutijin.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Hutijin fails a saving throw, he can spend a use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Hutijin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Hutijin regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Radiant damage suppresses this recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts a turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one attack each with Bite, Claw, Mace, and Tail.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) fire damage. The target must pass a DC 22 Constitution save or become poisoned. While poisoned by this bite, the target cannot regain hit points and takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It can repeat the save at each turn’s end, ending the effect on a success.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) cold damage.
Mace. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) force damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d10 + 8) thunder damage.
Teleport. Hutijin teleports up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see, taking worn and carried gear.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 22) with no material components.
At will. Alter Self (may become Medium when changing appearance), Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Invisibility (self only), Lightning Bolt, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
3/day. Dispel Magic.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Fearful Voice (Recharge 5–6). When Hutijin takes damage, each non-devil within 30 ft. makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of him for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save against Fearful Voice grants 24 hours of immunity to it.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Hutijin has 3 legendary actions and regains spent uses when his turn starts. He can use one option immediately after another creature’s turn, paying the listed cost. He must be able to take actions and cannot do so before the end of his own first turn if surprised.
Attack (1 action). Make one Claw, Mace, or Tail attack.
Teleport (1 action). Use Teleport.
Lightning Storm (2 actions). Every other creature within 30 ft. without total cover from him makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. Deal 18 (4d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Only total cover blocks the lightning.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Contaminated Nectar. One visible creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 10 Constitution save or gains 1 contamination level.
Hypnotic Pollen (short or long rest). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 10 Wisdom save or is Charmed for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it is Incapacitated and must spend all its movement getting as close as possible to the blossom on its turns. The effect ends if the target takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Spell Reflection. If the blossom saves against a non-area spell targeting only it, or a spell attack misses it, choose another visible creature within 30 ft., including the caster. Redirect the spell to that creature. The new target makes its own save if required, or the attack is rerolled against it.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: Description
lines: A medusa who rules the island of Skathos from a throne made of petrified devotees. She trades divine secrets for someone to add to it.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). Hythonia can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Petrifying Gaze. When a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see Hythonia’s eyes, she can force a DC 18 Constitution save if she can see the creature and is not incapacitated. Failure by 5 or more petrifies the creature immediately. A lesser failure restrains it as it turns to stone. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Success ends the effect and failure petrifies it. Greater Restoration or other magic can end the petrification. A creature that is not surprised can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the save. It cannot see Hythonia until its next turn starts and must make the save immediately if it looks before then. Seeing her reflection on a polished surface within 30 ft. in bright light subjects Hythonia to her own gaze.
Shed Skin (Mythic Trait, Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). At 0 HP, Hythonia sheds her skin, regains 199 HP, and moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks. She stays conscious and alive.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines: Charisma sets spell save DC 18. Hythonia casts Animate Objects once per day with no material components.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Claws attack, one Constrict attack, and one Snaky Hair attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and grappled (escape DC 19). The target is restrained until the grapple ends and takes 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. Hythonia cannot constrict a second target while this grapple lasts.
Snaky Hair. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Hythonia may also pull a Large or smaller creature up to 5 ft. closer.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Hythonia has 3 legendary actions per round. She can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains spent actions at the start of her turn.
Move (1 Action). Move up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Snaky Hair (1 Action). Make one Snaky Hair attack.
Petrified Earth (2 Actions). Stone spikes make the ground in a 30-ft. radius around Hythonia difficult terrain until the start of her next turn. Other creatures take 9 (2d8) piercing damage for every 5 ft. they move across the spikes.

gm.title: Mythic actions
lines:
Hythonia can spend legendary actions on these options for 1 hour after using Shed Skin. Award 36,000 XP in total if the party defeats her after she uses Shed Skin.
Numbing Claws (1 Action). Make two Claws attacks. If both hit the same creature, it takes an additional 7 (2d6) poison damage and must make a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it is paralyzed until the start of Hythonia’s next turn.
Look at Me (3 Actions). Force one sighted creature Hythonia has grappled to look into her eyes and face her Petrifying Gaze.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after any creature tied at 20, Hythonia can choose one effect. She cannot choose the same effect in consecutive rounds.
Animated Statues. Briefly animate creatures petrified by her gaze. Each statue attacks one creature within 5 ft. at +11 to hit for 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature that takes this damage is also grappled (escape DC 15).
Spectral Snakes. Choose a point Hythonia can see within 150 ft. Each creature within 20 ft. of it makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn. While poisoned this way, it has disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saves and acts as if affected by Confusion.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
One or more effects can manifest around the lair.
Snakes are abundant in the region.
Trees within 1 mile are petrified wood. A plant that remains within 500 ft. of the lair for a day turns to stone.
Small bodies of water within 1 mile are poisonous. A creature that drinks the water must make a DC 19 Constitution save or be poisoned for 8 hours. It can repeat the save at the end of each hour to end the poison early.

lines: Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness doesn’t impede the devil’s darkvision. Magic Resistance. The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

lines: Multiattack. The devil makes three attacks: one with its bite, one with its claws, and one with its tail. Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage. Claws. Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage. Tail. gm.title: Traits
lines:
Boon of Immortality. Magic and other effects cannot age Iggwilv, and old age cannot kill her.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Iggwilv fails a save, she can choose to pass it.
Magic Resistance. Her Robe of the Archmagi gives her advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Special Equipment. Iggwilv wears an Amulet of the Planes and a Robe of the Archmagi.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Bewitching Bolt attacks.
Bewitching Bolt. Melee or ranged spell attack, +16 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 120-ft. range, one target. A hit deals 25 (5d6 + 8) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 22 Wisdom save or be charmed by Iggwilv until her next turn starts.
Abyssal Rift (recharge 5–6). Open a momentary rift with a 20-ft. radius at a point within 120 ft. Creatures in the sphere make a DC 22 Constitution save, taking 40 (9d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Afterward, there is a 50% chance that three Hezrous appear in unoccupied spaces in the sphere. The demons are her allies and act immediately after her. They cannot summon other demons. They remain until they die or she uses an action to dismiss them.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence without material components. Spell save DC 24, spell attacks +16.
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Light, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation, Tasha’s Hideous Laughter.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fly, Polymorph.
1/day each. Maze, Telekinesis, Teleport, Wish.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Fey Step. Iggwilv teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 ft., taking anything she wears or carries.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Negate Spell (2/day). When Iggwilv sees a creature within 60 ft. casting a spell, she can interrupt it. A spell using a slot of level 8 or lower fails automatically. A 9th-level spell fails if its caster fails a DC 22 Intelligence save.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Iggwilv has three legendary actions and refreshes them when her turn starts. Spend them on one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Witchcraft (1 action). Use Spellcasting or Fey Step.
Dark Speech (2 actions). Choose one or two creatures Iggwilv can see within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage and is frightened of her for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the effect and grants immunity to her Dark Speech for 24 hours.
Fey Beguilement (3 actions). Choose a creature Iggwilv can see within 60 ft. It must pass a DC 22 Charisma save or a fey spirit possesses it and makes it obey her commands. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success banishes the spirit and ends the possession.

gm.title: Palace encounter
lines: The Hourglass Coven used Iggwilv’s Cauldron to freeze her and others in the palace. A frozen creature and its gear cannot be harmed or moved. As an action, touch Iggwilv with a unicorn horn while saying Natasha, her true name, to release her alone. Thaw the whole palace by touching the cauldron with the horn while reciting the Witch Queen’s Cauldron poem, or by shattering the cauldron with a Flame Tongue or Frost Brand weapon. Legend Lore can reveal the poem. Once freed, she can use the horn and poem to thaw the palace.

gm.title: Lich variant
lines: Use the 2014 Monster Manual lich for the base rules. This variant changes its CR, languages, and legendary actions, and adds Magic Resistance, Innate Spellcasting (Psionics), Tentacles, Extract Brain, and Mind Blast. Creating a phylactery and casting Imprisonment are prerequisites to becoming an illithilich. Feeding captured souls to its phylactery maintains its tentacle strength and ability to extract brains.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The illithilich can turn a failed save into a success.
Rejuvenation. If destroyed while its phylactery survives, the illithilich returns in 1d10 days at full hit points. Its new body appears within 5 ft. of the phylactery.
Turn Resistance. The illithilich has advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.
Magic Resistance. The illithilich has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Paralyzing Touch. Melee spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must make a DC 18 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) psychic damage. A target of Large size or smaller is grappled (escape DC 15) and must make a DC 20 Intelligence save or be stunned until the grapple ends.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid grappled by the illithilich. A hit deals 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If reduced to 0 hit points by this damage, the target dies as the illithilich extracts and eats its brain.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). The illithilich releases a 60 ft. cone of magical psychic energy. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 18 Intelligence save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d8 + 5) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

gm.title: Innate spellcasting (psionics)

At will. Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
The illithilich casts as an 18th-level wizard using Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost.
Level 1 (4 slots). Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Shield, Thunderwave.
Level 2 (3 slots). Detect Thoughts, Invisibility, Melf's Acid Arrow, Mirror Image.
Level 3 (3 slots). Animate Dead, Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Fireball.
Level 4 (3 slots). Blight, Dimension Door.
Level 5 (3 slots). Cloudkill, Scrying.
Level 6 (1 slot). Disintegrate, Globe of Invulnerability.
Level 7 (1 slot). Finger of Death, Plane Shift.
Level 8 (1 slot). Dominate Monster, Power Word Stun.
Level 9 (1 slot). Power Word Kill.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The illithilich has 3 legendary actions. It can use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It must be able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Tentacles (1 action). Make one Tentacles attack.
Extract Brain (2 actions). Use Extract Brain.
Mind Blast (3 actions). Recharge and use Mind Blast.
Cast Spell (1–3 actions). Spend a spell slot to cast a prepared 1st-, 2nd-, or 3rd-level spell. The cost is one legendary action per level of the spell.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
Use one magical option on initiative count 20, losing ties. The illithilich must be able to act and cannot choose the same option on consecutive rounds. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Recover Spell Slot. Roll a d8 and recover one spent slot of the rolled level or lower, if any.
Negative Energy Tether. Tether a visible creature within 30 ft. to the illithilich. Each time the illithilich takes damage, the target makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, the illithilich takes half the damage (rounded down) and the target takes the rest. The tether ends on initiative count 20 in the next round or when either creature leaves the lair.
Attack of the Dead. Spirits of creatures that died in the lair strike one visible creature within 60 ft. and disappear. The target makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 52 (15d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

lines:

lines:

A target that suffers harm or receives a suicidal command can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success. After a successful save against the effect or when it ends, the target is immune to this fiend's Charm for 24 hours. The fiend can charm only one target at once. Charming a new target ends the effect on the previous one.
Draining Kiss. Kiss a willing creature or one under the fiend's Charm. It makes a DC 15 Constitution save against this magic, taking 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. Reduce its hit point maximum by the damage dealt until it finishes a long rest. It dies if this reduction brings its maximum to 0.
Etherealness. The fiend uses magic to move between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane.

lines:

gm.title: Description
lines: A brain on clawed legs stalks the Underdark. It can steal a host, use its memories, and lure others to mind flayers.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: An exposed brain that scuttles on four clawed legs.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

gm.title: Senses
lines: Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 12.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Deep Speech. Cannot speak. Telepathy 60 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Detect Sentience. Senses the presence and location of creatures within 300 ft. that have Intelligence 3 or higher. Barriers do not block this sense. Mind blank protects a creature from it.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Claws attack and use Devour Intellect.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Devour Intellect. One visible creature within 10 ft. that has a brain makes a DC 12 Intelligence save against this magic. On failure it takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage. Also roll 3d6 on that failure. If the roll meets or exceeds the target's Intelligence score, reduce the score to 0. The creature is Stunned until it regains at least 1 Intelligence.
Body Thief. Make a contested Intelligence check against an Incapacitated humanoid within 5 ft. that lacks protection from evil and good. If the devourer wins, it magically consumes the humanoid's brain, teleports into its skull, and controls its body.
While inside, the devourer has Total Cover against attacks and other effects from outside the host. It keeps its Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, traits, understanding of Deep Speech, and telepathy. It takes the host's other statistics and knows everything the host knew, including languages and spells.
Body Thief ends when the host dies, protection from evil and good is cast on the body, or wish restores the brain. The devourer can leave voluntarily by spending 5 ft. of movement to teleport to the nearest empty space within 5 ft. If it leaves and the brain is not restored within 1 round, the body dies.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Body Thief includes the 2015 Monster Manual errata for the 2014 rules. The errata bars protected targets and uses the host's death to force departure. The early printing triggers departure at 0 HP.

gm.title: Attacks
lines: Claws · melee · +4 to hit · reach 5 ft. · 2d4 + 2 slashing

gm.title: Description
lines: This walking brain hunts for bodies it can occupy. It uses the host's knowledge to hide the substitution and serve its mind flayer creators.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak. Telepathy 60 ft..

gm.title: Traits
lines: Detect Intelligence. It magically locates creatures within 300 ft. whose Intelligence is 3 or higher. Barriers can't block this sense.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Claw attack and use Devour Intellect.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
Devour Intellect. One visible creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Intelligence save. Failure deals 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and leaves the target Stunned until the end of the intellect devourer's next turn.
Steal Body. Target one Small or Medium Humanoid or Beast within 5 ft. that is Incapacitated and has 10 HP or fewer. The target makes a DC 12 Intelligence save. On a failure, the intellect devourer possesses the target, eats its brain, and teleports into its skull.
Inside the host, the intellect devourer has Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside. It uses the host's statistics except for its own Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, understanding of Deep Speech, telepathy, and Detect Intelligence. It acquires the host's knowledge, including spells and languages.
The intellect devourer must leave if the host body dies or Wish restores the host's brain. It can also spend 5 ft. of movement to leave voluntarily, teleporting to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the host. The vacated body dies unless its brain returns before the end of the intellect devourer's next turn.

gm.title: Directed hunter
lines: The stalker waits with its summoner until given a task. It can be tasked to find and kill a specific creature or retrieve an object. Any other assignment breaks the binding and releases the stalker. When it finishes, it returns for more orders while the binding lasts. If its summoner dies before the task is done, it vanishes once it completes the task. Defeat or expiration of the binding also dismisses it. It resents its orders and may exploit vague wording on long assignments.

lines: Parry. The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the captain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon. It takes a strong personality, ruthless cunning, and a silver tongue to keep a gang of bandits in line. The bandit captain has these qualities in spades. In addition to managing a crew of selfish malcontents, the pirate captain is a variation of the bandit captain, with a ship to protect and command. To keep the crew in line, the captain must mete out rewards and punishment on a regular basis. More than treasure, a bandit captain or pirate captain craves infamy. A prisoner who appeals to the captain’s vanity or ego is more likely to be treated fairly than a prisoner who does not or claims not to know anything of the captain’s colorful reputation.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Inscrutable. Isperia is immune to effects that sense her emotions or read her thoughts. Divination spells affect her only with her permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks to discern her intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Isperia fails a saving throw, she can succeed instead.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:

Level 1 (4 slots). Command, Detect Evil and Good, Ensnaring Strike, Sanctuary, Shield of Faith.
Level 2 (3 slots). Arcane Lock, Augury, Calm Emotions, Hold Person, Silence, Zone of Truth.

Level 5 (2 slots). Dispel Evil and Good, Scrying.

Level 7 (1 slot). Divine Word.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. Isperia can replace one with a spell that takes 1 action to cast.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage after each attack it makes against Isperia before the start of Isperia’s next turn.
Supreme Legal Authority. Choose up to three creatures Isperia can see within 90 ft. Each makes a DC 23 Intelligence saving throw. For each failure, choose one action the target cannot take for 1 minute: Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, or Use an Object. The target can repeat the DC 23 Intelligence save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to Isperia’s Supreme Legal Authority for 24 hours.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one legendary action option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Cast a prepared spell of 3rd level or lower, spending a spell slot.
Supreme Legal Authority (3 actions). Use Supreme Legal Authority.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Olothec lairs, p. 200. Slime servants, p. 201. Stat block, p. 202.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Ithu’rath breathes air and water.
Immutable Form. Its shape cannot be changed by powers, spells, or other effects.
Slimy Resistance (3/day). Ithu’rath can turn a failed save into a success. Targets have advantage on the save against Devolving Tentacle until the end of Ithu’rath’s next turn.
Supernatural Resistance. Ithu’rath has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make six Devolving Tentacle attacks and use Piscine Transformation.
Devolving Tentacle. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage. On the first hit against a creature each turn, it must make a DC 19 Constitution save or become slimed. It subtracts a d4 from each attack roll and ability check. The penalty die increases one step at the end of each of its turns, from d4 to d6, d8, d10, then d12. The target can repeat the save at the end of each turn. Cure Ailment or Lesser Restoration also ends the slime.
Piscine Transformation (3rd-order power). Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. with a head, legs, or torso. On a failed DC 19 Wisdom save, choose one transformation. A fish head prevents speech. Fins reduce walking speed to 10 ft. if it was higher and give a 30-ft. swim speed. A fish torso allows breathing only in water and grants the ability to hold breath for 1 hour. If it gains a torso out of water, it begins suffocating. A 4th-order or higher Cure Ailment or Greater Restoration ends the transformation. All three changes together permanently make a fishlike hybrid, reversible by Wish or a similar supernatural effect.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Jaunt (3rd-order power). Teleport 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Liquefy (3rd-order power). When a creature within 30 ft. hits Ithu’rath with an attack, it must pass a DC 19 Constitution save or be pushed 5 ft. away and Restrained until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Villain Actions
lines:
Each villain action is available once per encounter. Use one at most per round, in any order, immediately after an enemy's turn.
1. Skeletal Collapse. Choose one or more creatures with skeletons within 60 ft. On a failed DC 19 Constitution save a target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and has disadvantage on Strength- and Dexterity-based checks, attacks, and saves for 1 minute, with an end-of-turn save.
2. Psychic Pulse. Each enemy within 60 ft. must pass a DC 19 Strength save or take 18 (4d8) force damage and be moved up to 30 ft. in a direction Ithu’rath chooses.
3. Slime Storm. Each creature within 60 ft., except olothecs and slime servants, makes a DC 19 Constitution save. A failure deals 45 (10d8) piercing damage and Blinds the target until the end of its next turn. A successful save halves the damage and avoids blindness.

gm.title: Lair Rules
lines: Use the Olothec lair actions when running Ithu’rath in its lair. The three options retain the DC 15 saves listed in the Olothec chapter. The same chapter gives the Slime Servant template.

gm.title: Psionic Powers (MCDM)
lines: Psionic powers require no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not stop powers. Melee power attacks can be used for opportunity attacks.

gm.title: Flanked (MCDM)
lines: When using the optional flanking rules, the immunity prevents enemies from flanking Ithu’rath.

lines: Speed · 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.

gm.title: Description
lines: A lone dragonlike hunter that stalks old forests and ruins. It can run upright or on all fours and fires beams from its eyes.

gm.title: Damage vulnerabilities
lines: Slashing damage from a Vorpal Sword.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Confusing Burble. The jabberwock burbles while it is not incapacitated. A creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. and can hear it must make a DC 18 Charisma save. On a failure, it has no reactions until its next turn starts, and rolls 1d4 for its current turn. On 1–2, it does nothing. On 3, it only spends all its movement in a random direction. On 4, it makes one melee attack against a random visible creature in reach, or does nothing if none is in reach.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the jabberwock fails a save, it can choose to pass it.
Regeneration. The jabberwock heals 10 hit points when its turn starts. Any slashing damage shuts off the healing at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn at 0 hit points and does not regenerate.
Uncanny Tracker. It can track creatures it wounded within the last 24 hours and knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as they share a plane.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Fiery Gaze (recharge 5–6). The jabberwock projects fire from its eyes in a line 120 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Creatures in the line make a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The jabberwock cannot use this action while blinded.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The jabberwock refreshes its three legendary actions when its turn starts. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make one Tail attack.
Rend Attack (2 actions). Make one Rend attack.
Wing Attack (3 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and falls prone.

gm.title: Hunting and return
lines: The jabberwock attacks its chosen prey until it kills it, the prey escapes, or the jabberwock dies. After one dies, another appears in 3d8 years within 1,000 miles of the place it died.

gm.title: Palace encounter
lines: The jabberwock sleeps around Iggwilv’s Cauldron in P22. Loud noise, an attack against it, or disturbing the cauldron wakes it. It follows prey or music out of the palace. If the great owl Bloodybeak does not attack it as soon as it leaves, it hunts for 1d6 + 2 hours before returning. Food may distract it long enough to slip away. It is friendly to Iggwilv the Witch Queen and hostile to others. Snicker-Snock, the Vorpal Sword in P50, exploits its damage vulnerability.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, appendix C, p. 236. See chapter 5, ballroom P22, Beware the Jabberwock, and vault P50 for the palace encounter.

gm.title: Description
lines: Spiteful cold spirits travel in flurries, weakening prey with vapor or mesmerizing snow before closing in humanoid form.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +2 as printed. AC components +1 size and +4 Dex in humanoid form. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 11. Base attack +1, grapple +1. Space and reach 5 ft. each in humanoid form, or 10-ft. space and 0-ft. reach in alternate forms. Fort +1, Ref +7, Will +5.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Touch +2 melee for 1d6 cold, or bite +2 melee for 1d3 damage and Frostbite.
Frostbite (Su). A bitten creature makes a DC 15 Fortitude save or takes 1d6 additional nonlethal damage and is fatigued until that damage is removed. This is a cold effect.
Freezing Vapor (Su). In vapor form, pass through an enemy’s space as a move action. A creature passed through takes 3d6 cold, Reflex DC 14 half. A foe can take this damage from only one jack frost per round. Creatures killed by it freeze solid.
Sparkling Snow (Su). In snow form, use a 30-ft. gaze that works as hypnotic pattern, Will DC 14.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Cold subtype. Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action, become vapor or sparkling snow indefinitely. Either form works as gaseous form with the printed space and reach, perfect flight 60 ft., and no running.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Bluff +6, Escape Artist +8, Hide +12, Listen +7, Move Silently +8, Spot +7. Dodge.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Mountains and cold lands. Flurry of 10–30. Usually neutral evil. Standard treasure. Advancement 4–6 HD (Small).

gm.title: Table notes
lines: Initiative is +2 in the printed table despite Dexterity 18. Retain the printed modifier.

gm.title: Description
lines: A jackal with the power to take human form. Jackalweres waylay travelers and use their sleep gaze to capture victims for lamias.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A jackal that can pass as a human or take a jackal-headed hybrid form.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Common. It can't speak in jackal form.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action it takes the form of a specific Medium human, a Medium jackal-humanoid hybrid, or its true Small jackal form. Only its size can change its statistics. Its equipment keeps its form. When it dies, the jackalwere returns to its true form.
Keen Hearing and Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics. It has advantage on attacks against a creature if one or more of its allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and that ally is not Incapacitated.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite (jackal or hybrid form). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Scimitar (human or hybrid form). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Sleep Gaze. One creature the jackalwere can see within 30 ft. must make a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure, magical sleep makes it Unconscious for 10 minutes, or until someone spends an action shaking it awake. A successful save makes the creature immune to this jackalwere's gaze for 24 hours. Undead and creatures immune to Charmed are unaffected.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.

gm.title: Description
lines: A jackal is the fiend's natural form. It uses a human disguise and a sleep-inducing gaze to trick or rob travelers.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Pack Tactics. The jackalwere has Advantage on an attack roll if at least one ally without the Incapacitated condition is within 5 ft. of the target.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

On a failure, the target is Unconscious for up to 10 minutes. Taking damage wakes it, as does a creature within 5 ft. spending an action to wake it. Success gives immunity to this jackalwere's Sleep Gaze for 24 hours.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Shape-Shift. Take the shape of a Medium human or a Medium jackal-humanoid hybrid, or return to its true Small jackal form. Game statistics are shared across forms except for the listed differences. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.

gm.title: Jackalwere tricks
lines:
Roll 1d4 or choose a trick.
1. Lead travelers into the wilds and leave them stranded.
2. Sketch a shortcut through a monster lair.
3. Put travelers to sleep and steal their mounts or supplies.
4. Promise treasure where sunlight glints off sand or water.

gm.title: Description
lines: A barnacle-like plant that clamps onto spelljamming hulls and feeds on their magic. Its reddish-purple body hides inside a shell that matches the hull.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Spelljammer Overload. If the leech drops to 0 HP while attached to a ship with a spelljamming helm, the creature attuned to that helm makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 10 (4d4) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. On a success it takes half damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Unusual Nature. The leech needs neither air nor sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Spiked Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Attach to Hull. Fasten to a ship's hull in the leech's space, dealing 2 (1d4) piercing damage to the ship regardless of its damage threshold. This damage cannot be repaired until the leech is scraped off. While attached, the leech has speed 0 and can detach as a bonus action. A creature within reach can spend an action and make a DC 18 Strength check to scrape it off. Failure leaves it in place. Scraping it off deals no damage to the leech or the ship.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Magical Discharge (1/day). When the leech takes damage, it can fire at a creature it can see within 30 ft. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) force damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Ecology
lines: Spores settle on hulls, then puncture them after a few days and grow shells about 1 ft. across. A mated pair produces 1d6 spores per month.

gm.title: Description
lines: The Devkarin lich leads the Golgari Swarm, whose kraul legions and undercity creatures protect his seat in the guild.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Jarad fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Jarad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Jarad regains 25 HP at the start of his turn. Taking fire or radiant damage suppresses this recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Turn Resistance. Jarad has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.
Undead Fortitude. If damage drops Jarad to 0 HP, he makes a Constitution saving throw with DC 5 + the damage taken. On a success, he drops to 1 HP. This trait does not apply to radiant damage or damage from a critical hit.
Undead Nature. Jarad needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
Jarad casts as a 14th-level Golgari wizard. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
Level 1 (4 slots). Entangle, Ray of Sickness, Sleep.
Level 2 (3 slots). Melf's Acid Arrow, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spider Climb, Web.
Level 3 (3 slots). Animate Dead, Plant Growth, Vampiric Touch.
Level 4 (3 slots). Blight, Giant Insect, Grasping Vine.
Level 5 (2 slots). Cloudkill, Insect Plague.
Level 6 (1 slot). Circle of Death, Create Undead.
Level 7 (1 slot). Finger of Death, Forcecage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Noxious Touch attack and one Staff of Svogthir attack. Jarad can replace one attack with a spell that takes 1 action to cast.
Noxious Touch. Melee spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 28 (8d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Staff of Svogthir. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, 13 (3d8) poison damage, and 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Spore Infusion. Choose one creature Jarad can see within 10 ft. His spores deal 11 (2d10) poison damage to it.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one legendary action option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast a cantrip.
Noxious Touch (2 actions). Use Noxious Touch.
Disrupt Life (3 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Description
lines: Port Nyanzaru's merchant prince for plants, poisons, and sanctioned killings. She keeps her worsening death curse hidden beneath bandages.

gm.title: Hit point rule
lines: The listed dice are for the Assassin base. Jessamine starts the adventure with a maximum of 58 HP, down from the base average of 78.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Thieves' Cant and any two other languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Assassinate. On her first turn, Jessamine has advantage on attacks against creatures that have yet to act. A hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Evasion. If a Dexterity save would let her take half damage, she takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Sneak Attack (once per turn). A weapon hit deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage if she attacks with advantage. She can also add this damage without advantage if she has no disadvantage and an ally who isn't incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.

gm.title: Death curse
lines: Jessamine was restored to life years ago, so the Soulmonger reduces her maximum HP by 1 each midnight after the adventure begins. The loss cannot be restored while it is active. She dies at a maximum of 0 HP, and the curse traps her soul if she dies while the Soulmonger remains active.

gm.title: Encounter context
lines: Jessamine is inclined to help anyone trying to end the curse. At the council she speaks little and often breaks ties. She sells poisons at market price and controls the city's lawful writs for sanctioned killings.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Tomb of Annihilation, ch. 1, p. 26, and Death Curse, p. 6. Use the Assassin from Monster Manual (2014), p. 343, with maximum HP reduced to 58 at the adventure's start.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack or full attack. Touch +3 melee.
Cackling Touch (Su). On a touch hit, a living target makes a DC 14 Fortitude save. Success means 1d6 hit point damage only. gm.title: Description
lines: The demon lord of oozes consumes living matter and turns it into more slime. Its many red eyes shift through a roiling body that can rise 20 feet above the ground.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Acid, poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Foul. Any creature other than an Ooze that starts its turn within 10 ft. of Juiblex must pass a DC 21 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Juiblex fails a saving throw, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Juiblex has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Juiblex regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. Fire or radiant damage suppresses that recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Spider Climb. Juiblex climbs difficult surfaces and can move upside down on ceilings without an ability check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Acid Lash attacks.
Acid Lash. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) acid damage. A creature killed by this attack is pulled inside Juiblex and its corpse dissolves after 1 minute.
Eject Slime (Recharge 5–6). One visible creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity save or take 55 (10d10) acid damage. If the target takes any of this damage, any metal armor it wears suffers a permanent cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it grants. Any metal weapon the target carries or wears suffers a permanent cumulative −1 penalty to its damage rolls. An item is destroyed when its penalty reaches −5. Mending can remove the penalty on an object.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 20) with no material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Contagion, Gaseous Form.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Juiblex has 3 legendary actions and regains spent uses when its turn starts. It can use one option immediately after another creature’s turn, paying the listed cost. It must be able to take actions and cannot do so before the end of its own first turn if surprised.
Attack (1 action). Make one Acid Lash attack.
Corrupting Touch (2 actions). Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) poison damage and coats the target in slime. The target is poisoned until the slime is removed by spending an action to scrape it off. While the slime remains, any non-Ooze creature within 10 ft. of the target is poisoned.

gm.title: Lair
lines: Juiblex shares the Slime Pits of Shedaklah, a layer of the Abyss, with Zuggtmoy. In its lair, Juiblex is CR 24 (62,000 XP).

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, use one option while in the lair and able to take actions. If surprised, Juiblex must finish its first turn first. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds.
Green Slime. A patch of the Green Slime hazard appears on a ceiling spot Juiblex chooses in the lair and disintegrates after 1 hour.
Slippery Slime. Coat a visible square on the lair floor, up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature on the square when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity save or fall prone and slide 10 ft. in a random direction (roll 1d8).
Sticky Slime. Coat a visible square on the lair floor, up to 10 ft. on each side. At the same three triggers, a creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength save or be restrained while it remains in the area. It or another creature that can reach it can spend an action on a DC 21 Strength check, freeing it on a success.
Slippery and Sticky Slime last for 1 hour or until burned away. Burning slime disappears after 1 round and deals 22 (4d10) fire damage to creatures starting their turns in it.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Acidic Water. Small bodies of water within 1 mile turn acidic and corrode objects that touch them.
Corrupted Nature. Within 6 miles, Wisdom (Medicine) and Wisdom (Survival) checks have disadvantage.
Slime. Within 6 miles, surfaces are frequently coated with a slick film that sticks to whatever touches it.
The region can show one or more effects. They fade over 1d10 days after Juiblex dies.

gm.title: Description
lines: Eyes flicker in a heap of black and green ooze. Juiblex rules the Slime Pits of Shedaklah, where victims it consumes can become sentient oozes.

gm.title: Damage immunities
lines: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.

gm.title: Condition immunities
lines: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Foul. Any creature other than an ooze that starts its turn within 10 ft. of Juiblex must pass a DC 21 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of that creature's next turn.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Juiblex can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Juiblex has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Juiblex's weapon attacks are magical.
Regeneration. Juiblex regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If Juiblex takes fire or radiant damage, it does not regenerate at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 hit points and cannot regenerate.
Spider Climb. Juiblex can climb difficult surfaces and hang from ceilings without an ability check.

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Juiblex uses Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Acid Splash (17th level), Detect Magic.
3/day each. Blight, Contagion, Gaseous Form.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three Acid Lash attacks.
Acid Lash. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) acid damage. Juiblex draws in a creature this attack kills and destroys the corpse after 1 minute.
Eject Slime (Recharge 5–6). Pick one creature Juiblex can see within 60 ft. A failed DC 21 Dexterity save deals 55 (10d10) acid damage. If the target takes any of this damage, each metal armor piece it wears grants 1 less AC and each metal weapon it wears or carries takes a −1 penalty to damage rolls. These penalties are permanent and cumulative. An item is destroyed once its penalty reaches −5.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
Juiblex has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. Use only one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn.
Acid Splash (1 action). Cast Acid Splash.
Attack (1 action). Make one Acid Lash attack.
Corrupting Touch (2 actions). Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) poison damage and coats the target in slime. The target is poisoned. Other creatures besides oozes are poisoned while within 10 ft. of the target. Scraping off the slime takes an action and ends both effects.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
On initiative count 20, after creatures tied on that count have acted, Juiblex may choose one option. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds.
Restraining slime. Coat a visible square of ground up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature there when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must pass a DC 21 Strength save or be restrained while in the area. The restrained creature or another creature within reach can spend an action to free it with a DC 21 Strength check.
Slippery slime. Coat a visible square of ground up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature there when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must pass a DC 21 Dexterity save or fall prone and slide 10 ft. in a random direction determined by a d8.
Either ground slime lasts 1 hour. Fire burns it away after 1 round. A creature starting its turn in burning slime takes 22 (4d10) fire damage.
Green Slime. A patch of Green Slime appears on a spot Juiblex chooses on the lair ceiling. It disintegrates after 1 hour.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The region around Juiblex’s lair gains one or more of these effects.
Within 1 mile, small bodies of water become acidic and corrode objects that touch them. Within 6 miles, slick, sticky slime often coats surfaces.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll on Madness of Juiblex. A success gives 24 hours of immunity to that regional effect.
The regional effects fade over 1d10 days after Juiblex dies.

gm.title: Madness of Juiblex
lines:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or in Juiblex's line of sight, roll d100. The flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. The creature compulsively consumes everything it can.
21–40. It refuses to give up anything it owns.
41–60. It urges others to eat and drink past their usual limits.
61–80. It tries to acquire as many possessions as possible.
81–100. It judges its own worth entirely by what it consumes.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Divine Eminence. As a bonus action, the priest can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the priest expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st. Spellcasting. The priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The priest has the following cleric spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy 1st level (4 slots): cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, spiritual weapon 3rd level (2 slots): dispel magic, spirit guardians Fey Ancestry. Advantage on saves against charm. Magical sleep fails. Sunlight Sensitivity. Direct sunlight imposes disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception checks. Innate spells use Cha, save DC 11, with no material components. At will: dancing lights. 1/day each: darkness, faerie fire.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Mace. Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. Priests bring the teachings of their gods to the common folk. They are the spiritual leaders of temples and shrines and often hold positions of influence in their communities. Evil priests might work openly under a tyrant, or they might be the leaders of religious sects hidden in the shadows of good society, overseeing depraved rites. A priest typically has one or more acolytes to help with religious ceremonies and other sacred duties.

gm.title: Description
lines: Jutkarr likes locks and guarded vaults for the same reason he likes the broadsheet’s puzzles. He plans the Amethyst Knife’s operations and keeps its supplies in order.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Breastplate. Saving throws Con +5, Int +9. History +9, Investigation +9, Perception +6, Religion +9. Resists poison and psychic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Common, Dwarvish, and thieves’ cant. Telepathy 120 ft.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Mind Link. The bosses of the Amethyst Knife can speak telepathically with one another across any distance on the same plane.
Poison Resistant. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Deserved Transfer attacks.
Deserved Transfer (2nd-order power). Melee or ranged power attack +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) psychic damage. A creature Jutkarr can see within 30 ft. gains temporary HP equal to half the damage dealt.
Psionic Resilience (2/day, 4th-order power). Touch a willing creature and give it immunity to one chosen condition for 1 hour. Choose Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, or Stunned. Suppress that condition for the same duration if the target already has it.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Shared Condition. When the creature becomes Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned, it can transfer the condition and its remaining duration to a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. who neither has the condition nor is immune to it. The condition ends for the original creature. This reaction works even while Incapacitated.

gm.title: Villain Party Action
lines:
Amethyst Knife. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 3, I Planned For This. An Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. of Jutkarr can swap places by teleporting with another willing boss in the same area. A boss must see the one it swaps with. No action required.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: While Dazed, a creature can use only one of its movement, action, or bonus action on its turn. Gaining Dazed ends the turn if it happens during that turn. Extra actions such as Haste or Action Surge still work. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

gm.title: Psionic Powers (MCDM)
lines: Powers have no components and count as supernatural. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not stop powers. A creature may maintain several different powers at once, up to its proficiency bonus, but cannot concentrate on a spell or another effect at the same time. Failing a concentration save ends all active powers. If a foe provokes an opportunity attack, the creature can use a melee power attack as its reaction instead.

gm.title: Description
lines: A leopardlike hunter with six snakes growing from its shoulders. It hunts alone or in pairs and uses a cloud of sleep gas before closing in.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Keen Smell. The kamadan has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on scent.
Pounce. If it moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with Claw on the same turn, the target must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone. If this knocks the target prone, the kamadan can use a bonus action to make one Bite and one Snakes attack against it.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite or Claw attack, plus one Snakes attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Snakes. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The creature also makes a DC 12 Constitution save, taking 21 (6d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Sleep Breath (recharges after a short or long rest). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or fall unconscious for up to 10 minutes. Damage or an action spent waking the creature ends the effect early.

gm.title: Hunting tactics
lines: A kamadan opens with Sleep Breath if it can, then attacks conscious enemies before turning on sleeping ones.

gm.title: Description
lines: Kelek founded the League of Malevolence and wants to take Ringlerun’s Staff of Power. He makes a show of ruthlessness and falls back on magic when threatened.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Special Equipment. Kelek wears Bracers of Defense and starts with a fully charged Staff of Striking (10 charges). Each dawn, the staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges. When the last charge is spent, roll a d20. On a 1, it becomes an ordinary quarterstaff.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using any combination of Sorcerer’s Bolt and Staff of Striking. Kelek can cast one spell from Spellcasting in place of one attack.
Sorcerer’s Bolt. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d12) force damage.
Staff of Striking. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, or 9 (1d8 + 5) if wielded with two hands. On a hit, spend up to three charges to add 3 (1d6) force damage per charge.
Fiery Explosion (Recharge 4–6). Choose a point Kelek can see within 120 ft. The point erupts in magical fire. Every creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere around it makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. It takes 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failure, or half on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 14).
At will. Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Dominate Beast, Fly, Mirror Image, Web.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Arcane Defense (3/day). When an attack hits Kelek, an invisible barrier adds 5 to his AC through the end of his next turn. Apply the bonus to the triggering attack as well.

gm.title: Combat notes
lines: Use Arcane Defense when Kelek’s low AC leaves him exposed. He uses Fiery Explosion whenever practical, even when allies are in the blast.

gm.title: Description
lines: A squat, winged bureaucrat of Carceri whose skin oozes acid. Kelubars often send Farastu Demodands to fight in their place.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A winged Carceri fiend with a heavy body and acid-slick skin.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Acidic Secretions. A creature that touches the kelubar or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. takes 5 (2d4) acid damage.
Boundless Movement. Difficult terrain does not slow the kelubar, and magic cannot reduce its speed. It can spend 5 ft. of movement to end the grappled condition on itself.
Magic Resistance. The kelubar saves with advantage against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing plus 18 (4d8) acid damage on a hit.
Spit Acid. Each creature in a 60-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) acid damage. On a success, it takes half.
Summon Demodand (1/Day). The kelubar has a 40 percent chance to summon its choice of 1d2 Farastu Demodands or one Kelubar Demodand. Each summoned demodand appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft., acts as an ally, and cannot summon demodands. A summoned ally remains for up to 1 minute. It disappears early if it or its summoner dies, or if the summoner dismisses it as an action.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Charisma, save DC 17. No material components. Cast Invisibility on itself at will. Dispel Magic and Scrying are each available once per day. Scrying takes an action.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Nauseating Fog (Recharge 6). Center a magical green cloud on a point within 120 ft. The 20-ft.-radius cloud is heavily obscured and counts as difficult terrain. It lasts 1 minute or until the kelubar uses this bonus action again. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud or enters it for the first time on a turn must pass a DC 17 Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

gm.title: Demodands
lines: A demodand that dies outside Carceri re-forms in Carceri after 2d20 days.

gm.title: Description
lines: A kenku warlock disrupts the Witchlight Carnival to learn why she lost contact with her patron Zybilna. She passes among the visitors using Disguise Self and speaks in the voice she stole from Candlefoot.

gm.title: Languages
lines: Understands Auran and Common. She speaks through Mimicry.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Mimicry. She can reproduce voices and any other sounds she has heard. A listener needs a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check to recognize an imitation.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Twilight Sleep (2/day). Choose one creature she can see within 10 ft. Magical gas forces a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is unconscious for 1 minute. Damage wakes it immediately, as does another creature using an action to shake or slap it awake.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 13).
At will. Disguise Self, Friends, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Bestow Curse, Faerie Fire, Speak with Animals.

gm.title: Encounter notes
lines: After an hour searching the carnival, a character can see through her disguise with a successful DC 13 Intelligence (Investigation) check. She flees to break line of sight and may talk to adventurers who say they are investigating the carnival. Her pact prevents her from entering Prismeer. She presses Mister Witch and Mister Light for answers and asks adventurers to find out what happened to Zybilna. Untie the thorny stem around her cornhusk doll to restore Candlefoot’s voice. A successful DC 12 Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check persuades her to hand over the doll.
