gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +11, Con +10, Wis +10, Cha +12. Arcana +11, Athletics +11, Deception +12, History +11, Perception +10, Stealth +9. Resists necrotic damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks Abyssal, Common, Draconic, and Infernal.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Rejuvenation. The destroyed lich takes refuge in its soulstone if it is intact. A creature that can see the occupied stone at the start of its turn must pass a DC 20 Charisma save or become Charmed by the stone until the end of its next turn. The Charmed creature tries its hardest to reach and touch the stone while avoiding obvious hazards. Any creature that touches the occupied stone makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, the toucher drops to 0 HP and the lich returns at full HP. On a success, the toucher loses half its current HP and the lich returns at half HP. Either way, the lich reforms in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the stone. The stone has AC 19, 50 HP, and immunity to every damage type except force and thunder.
Supernatural Resistance. The lich has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
Turn Immunity. Effects that turn Undead have no effect on the lich.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Glare of Undeath and make four attacks in any combination of Biting Acid, Disruptive Thunder, and Pain of Ages.
Biting Acid (3rd-level spell). Ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 120-ft. range, one target. Hit 22 (5d8) acid damage. The target cannot regain HP until the start of the lich's next turn.
Disruptive Thunder (3rd-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 60-ft. range, one target. Hit 22 (4d10) thunder damage. Move a Huge or smaller target up to 45 ft. horizontally.
Pain of Ages (3rd-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 90-ft. range, one creature. Hit 21 (6d6) psychic damage. The first attack the target lands before the start of the lich's next turn deals half damage.
Glare of Undeath. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. On failure it clutches itself and becomes Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. A creature it hears and understands can use an action to end the effect with a successful DC 20 Charisma (Persuasion) check.
Horrid Woe (2/day). One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A target reduced to 0 HP becomes stable and cannot heal. Its spirit appears as a wraith in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the body. It obeys the lich's spoken commands and acts immediately after the lich on the same turn. When the lich or wraith is destroyed, the spirit returns to the body and the target can regain HP.
Life Absorption (1/day, 9th-level spell, concentration). Each enemy within 120 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, for 1 minute the enemy takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The lich gains temporary HP equal to the total damage dealt.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Necrotic Form (3rd-level spell). Become a shadow and move up to the lich's speed. In this form, the lich is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and to Grappled and Restrained, and can pass through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. The form ends at the end of its turn.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Immortal Insight. When another visible creature rolls an attack, ability check, or saving throw, the lich can impose advantage or disadvantage.

gm.title: Utility Spells
lines: Charisma, spell save DC 20. At will: Arcane Lock, Charm Person, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Identify, Locate Object, Mage Hand. Three times per day each: Arcane Eye, Arcanist's Magic Aura, Contact Other Plane, Legend Lore, Scrying. Once per day each: Forbiddance, Geas, Hallow, Mirage Arcane, Symbol. Identify, Contact Other Plane, Legend Lore, Scrying, and the once-per-day spells use their listed casting times. The others take 1 action.

Spirit Shell. Until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round, anyone who hits the lich with a melee attack must pass a DC 20 Wisdom save or be Dazed until the start of their next turn.
Unnatural Born Leader. One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed and make a weapon attack against a creature the lich chooses.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses just one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If the creature becomes Dazed during its turn, the turn ends. It still receives any extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or Greater Restoration can clear the condition.

Level 3, Silent Pounce (5 Ferocity). Teleport 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. The lightbender can make a signature attack before or after teleporting. On a hit, the target falls Prone.

lines: Shared Afterimage (long rest). When the lightbender or its caregiver is hit by an attack while they are within 30 ft. of each other, both are revealed as imprints. gm.title: Mystic connection
lines: Unleash Sunlight. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and Mystic Connection can spend a bonus action once per long rest to flash with bright light. Choose creatures within 10 ft. that can see the Beastheart. Each makes a Constitution save against the Beastheart’s exploit save DC or becomes Blinded for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the condition on a success.

gm.title: MCDM companion rules
lines:
Shared turn. The caregiver and companion act on the same turn. The companion moves and uses its reaction and bonus action independently. To do anything with its action besides Dash, Disengage or Dodge, it normally needs a command that costs the caregiver a bonus action. It must see or hear the caregiver. If the caregiver is Incapacitated, it can act without a command. The GM chooses who controls it when the caregiver is Incapacitated or absent.
Ferocity. At the start of their turn, unless Incapacitated, the companion gains 1d4 Ferocity plus one for each enemy it sees or hears within 5 ft. A swarm sharing one stat block counts as one enemy. Spend the listed cost before taking a Ferocity action. It uses the companion’s action, requires the listed caregiver level and is unavailable during a rampage.
Rampage. After rolling Ferocity, a companion with at least 10 Ferocity risks a rampage if it is not Incapacitated. A caregiver who is not Incapacitated and can be seen or heard can prevent it with a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check against DC 5 + Ferocity, without spending an action. If the companion rampages, it immediately moves toward the nearest creature it senses and makes its signature attack, with extra damage equal to half its Ferocity on a hit. If an ally and enemy tie for nearest, roll any die. On an odd roll the caregiver’s player chooses a tied ally. On an even roll they choose a tied enemy. If it cannot reach a target, it Dashes toward it. If it senses none, it moves as far as it can in a random safe direction. Ferocity falls to 0 after this action or at the end of the turn.
Recovery. At 0 HP, a companion makes death saves. After combat, Ferocity resets to 0. A companion that is not dying first regains HP equal to its remaining Ferocity.

gm.title: Heraldic servant rules
lines:
Printed source. Heraldic Servant, General, pp. 44–46.
A heraldic servant has an inactive form on its coat of arms and two active forms, one natural and one humanoid. The rightful bearer can summon one servant at any time. It must touch the coat of arms to return to it or transfer to another coat of arms.
Use the same hit points in either active form. Unless the entry gives an exception, use the same Armor Class and magical powers as well. Weapons and movement may depend on form. An active servant automatically defends its bearer unless ordered otherwise. It can only be killed while active.
An active servant and its bearer can share thoughts and senses telepathically within one mile. While linked, the bearer counts as one experience level higher and shares the servant's spell immunities and magic resistance. While the servant is inactive, personally carrying its coat of arms grants the extra level and magic resistance. Check the individual entry for additional benefits.
The servant's death removes all benefits and permanently costs its bearer two levels. The servant can return at the bearer's deathbed if a new generation takes over. Three consecutive unworthy generations lose its service until two consecutive generations prove worthy.
A heraldic servant needs neither food nor sleep and earns no XP. It remains neutral or takes its bearer's alignment. The Red Curse cannot give it Legacies or Affliction.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: Description
lines: A dream spirit bound to a living host. The six printed samples are companions of a 5th-level human fighter with 40 HP.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Construct; Medium incorporeal Dark Man shown in header

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Dark Man. Medium. Initiative +2, AC 13 (touch 12, flat-footed 11), BAB/grapple +3/+3, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft., Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +5. Attack or full attack is incorporeal touch +3 melee for 1d6 Strength damage. It fights as a shadow without creating spawn. Dodge. Hide, Listen, Spot and Survival each +8; Stealth adds +10 enhancement to Hide in shadows. Cooperation lends the host Hide while merged.
Living Spear. Medium object, 30 HP, hardness 5 or DR 10/magic, whichever applies; they do not stack. It cannot move independently. Use host BAB, attack and saves. Weapon damage 1d8 + 1. Dexterity 14, Int 4, Wis 14; no Str, Con or Cha. Guile can poison three penetrating attacks per day. Swiftness makes separation a free action and places it in the host’s hand.

gm.title: Traits
lines: All samples have 5d10 and 30 HP. Treat them as summoned creatures for XP; overcoming their host earns the award. All understand their host’s languages and have construct traits, DR 10/magic, Empathic Link, Merge and Life Bond. They cannot heal naturally or receive curing magic. A separated tattoo loses 1 HP per full 24 hours. A tattoo with an undead model cannot create spawn.

gm.title: Violet Panther
lines: Medium. Initiative +4, speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft., AC 15 (touch 14, flat-footed 11), BAB/grapple +3/+6, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +3. Str 16, Dex 19, Int 4, Wis 14, Cha 6. Claw +6 for 1d3 + 3; full attack two claws plus bite +1 for 1d6 + 3. Pounce, improved grab and rake 2d4 + 1 as a leopard. Scent, Stealth and darkvision 60 ft. Balance +12, Climb +11, Hide +9, Listen +7, Move Silently +9, Spot +7. Dodge and Weapon Finesse. It attacks without orders and must be told to stop.

gm.title: Grandfather Raven
lines: Tiny. Initiative +2, speed 10 ft., fly 40 ft. average, AC 14 (touch 14, flat-footed 12), BAB/grapple +3/−10, space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +2. Str 1, Dex 15, Int 4, Wis 14, Cha 6. Claw +4 for 1d2 − 5, two claws at full attack (minimum 1 damage on a hit). Listen +6, Spot +6, Weapon Finesse. Counsel grants discern lies and Worldliness grants tongues, each 1/day at CL 8.

gm.title: Winged Snake
lines: Small. Initiative +4, speed 40 ft., fly 100 ft. average, swim 40 ft., AC 15 (touch 11, flat-footed 15), BAB/grapple +3/+0, space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +6. Str 13, Dex 10, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 10. Claw +7 for 1d4; full attack two claws plus bite +2 for 1d6 + 1. Wyrmling green dragon breath: 20-ft. cone of acid for 2d6, DC 13 Reflex half. Guile applies to the bite. Electricity resistance 10, immune to acid, water breathing. Concentration +5, Diplomacy +5, Escape Artist +5, Listen +7, Search +5, Spot +7. Improved Initiative.

gm.title: Silver Wolf
lines: Medium. Initiative +2, speed 50 ft., AC 14 (touch 12, flat-footed 12), space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +2. Str 13, Dex 15, Int 4, Wis 13, Cha 6. Bite +3 for 1d6 + 1 with wolf trip: a hit allows a free trip attempt without an initial touch attack, and failure allows no counter-trip. Scent; while merged the host may use the tattoo’s scent and Survival as listed. Hide +3, Listen +6, Move Silently +4, Spot +4, Survival +1. Weapon Finesse.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Empathic Link is telepathy while touched or in line of sight. Merge or separate at will as a standard action; merging requires touch. While merged, damage to the host does not damage the tattoo. Attacks must specifically target the tattoo to harm it. Death of the host releases the spirit. Once per round as a free action the host can pay any number of their own HP to restore that many tattoo HP. The host recovers that loss only by natural healing. If the tattoo is destroyed, the host must make a Fortitude save at DC 10 + half tattoo HD or die. The site cannot hold another magic tattoo.

gm.title: Model abilities
lines: A host binds only one tattoo. The model must be no larger than the host and have fewer HD. Treat tattoo HD as the host’s level and HP as three-quarters of host HP rounded down. Keep model attacks and movement; objects cannot move on their own. Merged and object tattoos save as the host. Add two suitable powers: Caution, chosen energy resistance 10; Cooperation, one skill while merged; Counsel, discern lies 1/day; Excitement, +1d6 electricity on three attacks daily; Guile, three penetrating attacks daily poison at Fort DC 13 for initial 1d4 Str and secondary 1d4 Con; Mystery, blindness/deafness 1/day; Piety, prayer 1/day affecting tattoo and host; Stealth, +10 enhancement to Hide in shadows; Swiftness, free-action separation; Vigilance, darkvision 60 ft.; Worldliness, tongues 1/day. Use CL 8 for listed daily spell effects and DC 10 + tattoo Wis modifier + spell level.

gm.title: Bonding
lines: An Abber shaman’s rite takes 1d8 + 8 hours and deals 2d4 nonlethal damage to the host each hour. Afterward DC 14 Wisdom attracts a spirit. Bonding costs 200 XP per model HD, or 1/25 the object’s market price in XP with a minimum of 100 XP.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The header uses the Dark Man example. The six forms do not have independent printed CRs. The source omits independent speed and AC for Living Spear and BAB/grapple for Silver Wolf. Use host rolls for Spear where directed.

gm.title: Description
lines: Muffled pleading comes from behind apparent masonry. Get within reach and the voices turn into grasping hands.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +0. AC −1 size, +5 natural. Touch AC 9, flat-footed AC 14. Base attack +6, grapple +10. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +4.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Slam +10 melee (1d3 + 4) or short sword +10/+5 melee (1d6 + 4) in the printed examples. Full attack. Eight slams or eight short swords at the listed bonuses. Use the absorbed occupants to choose the wall’s real attacks.
Improved Grab (Ex) and Absorption (Su). Hit with an unarmed attack to attempt a grab, then pull the victim in. The victim must succeed on a Fortitude save, DC 10 + half the wall’s HD + its Strength modifier (DC 18 here), or be absorbed. Repeat each round the grapple continues. If the victim fails the save, allies trying to break the pin make the same save or are also absorbed. A creature killed or knocked unconscious within reach is absorbed on the wall’s next turn. True resurrection is the only way to restore an absorbed victim.
Animate Dead (Su). A corpse left within 300 ft. for a month becomes a zombie and walks into the wall. It never fights.
Spell-like abilities. An absorbed caster’s remaining spells become spell-like abilities, each usable once per day. The caster takes the wall’s alignment, which may remove class abilities.

gm.title: Gestalt Attacks (Ex)
lines: Each occupant adds its primary attack and keeps its base attack bonus. Use the higher of its Strength modifier and the wall’s, with no Dexterity modifier. Use +5 natural armor or the highest natural armor bonus among the occupants, whichever is higher. Magic equipment remains active, but bonuses of the same type do not stack. Magic weapons remain usable until their ammunition runs out. Ordinary objects fall to the foot of the wall.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Construct traits, spell resistance 14. Detect magic reveals its aura, true seeing pierces the false masonry, and seeing the true wall calls for a DC 20 Horror save. Within 15 ft., creatures can hear the voices. It speaks the languages of its occupants.
Insane (Ex). Mental contact calls for a Madness save, DC 10 + half the wall’s HD + its Wisdom modifier (DC 16 here). On a failure the DM chooses the derangement.
Magic Immunity (Su). Immune to flesh to stone and similar effects. Passwall and stone shape fail against its flesh. A caster using meld into stone on it is absorbed automatically.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines:
Solitary, on land or underground. Always chaotic evil. Double standard treasure. Feat: Multidexterity. The wall tries to absorb its creator. If it succeeds, it becomes ordinary stone and releases its souls.
It can absorb living creatures at least one size smaller. Add 1 HD for each Medium, two Small, four Tiny, or eight Diminutive creatures. Add 2 HD for a Large, 4 for a Huge, 8 for a Gargantuan, or 16 for a Colossal creature. It fills one 5-ft. cube per 3 HD, rounding down. The advancement lines give 9–15 HD (Large), 13–18 HD (Huge), and 19–26 HD (Gargantuan).

gm.title: Construction
lines: A 14th-level arcane caster needs at least three intact Medium humanoid corpses cemented into a 5-ft. cube, a DC 12 Craft (stoneworking) or Knowledge (engineering) check, 50,000 gp including 500 gp for the body, and 1,100 XP. The spells are animate dead, flesh to stone, limited wish, meld into stone, and stone to flesh. Prolonged deaths in a walled-up niche can also create one spontaneously.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The example attack profile depends on the occupants. The printed advancement ranges overlap at 13–15 HD.
The entry describes both absorption on the next turn within reach and the separate month-long animation of corpses within 300 ft.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks or two Psionic Repeater attacks, then use one power or Memory Transfer.
Tentacle. Melee attack +11, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit for 28 (4d10 + 6) psychic. A target no larger than Large is Grappled (escape DC 19).
Psionic Repeater. Ranged attack +11, range 150/600 ft. Hit for 22 (3d10 + 6) force.
Brain Overload (1/day, 6th-order power). Pick one visible creature within 120 ft. It makes a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 77 (14d10) psychic on failure or half on success. If the damage leaves a target with a brain at 0 HP, its brain bursts. The target dies if it needs that brain to survive.
Flay (6th-order power). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Intelligence save. Failure deals 35 (10d6) psychic. Success halves it.
Memory Transfer. Each creature Syuul is holding attempts a DC 19 Intelligence save. Failure deals 44 (8d10) psychic damage. A creature that failed and remains held at the end of its next turn chooses one of the two effects below.
Memory Transfer, stripped memory. The target loses its proficiency bonus, cannot speak or form new thoughts, and has disadvantage on checks, attacks and saves. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration or a similar supernatural effect ends this. Syuul gains +5 damage cumulatively until his next long rest.
Memory Transfer, command. Syuul Charms the target for 1 hour. His telepathic commands require no action and the target tries its best to follow them. Whenever it takes damage, it can make a DC 19 Wisdom save to end the effect.
Guise (3rd-order power). For 1 hour, project the appearance of a Medium creature previously seen, including alterations to carried gear. Physical contact reveals discrepancies. A creature can use an action and pass a DC 19 Intelligence (Investigation) check to detect the projection.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Grappling Jaunt. Teleport Syuul and every creature he is holding up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Brain Drain. Give a creature Syuul is holding disadvantage on its save against his Memory Transfer.

gm.title: Villain actions
lines:
Use each once per encounter, after an enemy’s turn, with a limit of one per round.
Mindblind. Visible enemies within 60 ft. make a DC 19 Wisdom save. Those that fail can see only Syuul among creatures for 1 minute. They repeat the save at the end of each turn.
Was I Ever Here? Syuul becomes Invisible, teleports 60 ft. to an unoccupied visible space, and can Hide. An illusion remains in his former space and behaves as he directs without an action. On first touching it on a turn, or on making a melee attack against it, a creature must pass a DC 19 Constitution save or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage. Both effects end at the end of Syuul’s next turn.
Mindshatter. Visible enemies within 60 ft. attempt a DC 19 Wisdom save. Failure deals 55 (10d10) psychic and leaves the enemy Dazed for 1 minute, with a new save at the end of each turn. Success halves damage and avoids Dazed.

gm.title: Psionics
lines:
Syuul’s psionic powers work through Antimagic Field and are unaffected by Counterspell and Dispel Magic.
MCDM Dazed. On its turn the affected creature chooses only one of movement, an action or a bonus action. Becoming dazed during its turn ends that turn. Additional actions granted by effects such as Haste are still available. Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration or Cure Ailment can remove Dazed.

gm.title: Lycanthrope encounter rules
lines:
Printed source. Lycanthrope, pp. 137 and 148.
Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.
Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.
Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Low-light vision and scent work in any form unless the profile specifies otherwise. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.
A spellcaster cannot use verbal, somatic, or material components in animal form and cannot use verbal components in hybrid form. Apply the printed encounter stats for each form.

gm.title: Sacrament of the Falling Fire
lines: A one-hour ritual in the Deep Haze with a 30-ft. range. Each of up to 12 willing, faithful Humanoids drives a 100 gp delerium fragment into their chest, becoming sanctified. Each participant is then attacked by a hostile Shadow, or a Wraith if the GM judges the participant’s anger, fear, or hatred warrants one. While keeping the faith, a sanctified creature has advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened, resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, and immunity to contamination. On death its soul enters the fragment and it cannot be raised while the soul remains there.

gm.title: Delerium contamination
lines:
Printed source. Appendix C, pp. 222–223.
Add contamination levels from each exposure. A contaminated character rolls 1d20 at the end of each long rest and gains one level on a 1.
Symptoms are cumulative. Level 1 has no symptom. Level 2 halves healing from Hit Dice. Level 3 prevents HP recovery from a long rest. Level 4 halves damage the creature deals with weapon attacks and spells. Level 5 makes it Incapacitated. Level 6 triggers Monstrous Transformation.
After a character gains a level, roll 1d6. On a result at or below the current level, the GM chooses a new mutation or rolls on the printed mutations table. Replace or reroll duplicate mutations.
Contamination does not wear off. Purge Contamination can remove levels and causes Exhaustion. Heal removes all contamination and mutations. Each level removed also removes one random mutation. At level 0, all symptoms and mutations end.
A contaminated humanoid rises as a Haze Husk 24 hours after death. It rises as a Haze Wight if it had at least six class levels or Hit Dice. Raising a creature from the dead reduces its contamination by one level.
Monstrous Transformation. At level 6 or higher, the creature transforms after one round. Replace its statistics, hit points, and Hit Dice with those of a monster the GM chooses. Contamination resets to 0, and the GM controls the transformed creature.
Wish or similar magic can restore one transformed creature, clearing its madness and contamination. Using Wish this way gives the caster a 33 percent chance of losing the ability to cast it again.

lines: Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Barbed Trunk attack and two Glaive attacks.
Barbed Trunk. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing and 13 (2d12) poison damage. A Medium or smaller creature is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained until the grapple ends. While holding it, the maelephant cannot use Barbed Trunk against anyone else.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.
Mind Poison (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 16 Constitution save. A failure deals 39 (6d12) poison damage and leaves the creature poisoned. While poisoned this way, it loses all weapon and skill proficiencies, cannot cast spells or understand language, and has disadvantage on Intelligence saves. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A success on the initial save deals half damage, causes no condition, and grants immunity to this maelephant’s Mind Poison for 24 hours.

gm.title: Description
lines: A Huge predator that tunnels through rock and can swallow creatures whole.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Immune to fire damage. Perception +7. Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 17. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Searing Presence. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the landshark takes 11 (2d10) fire damage.
Standing Leap. It can long jump 40 ft. or high jump 20 ft., even without a running start.
Illumination. Bright light within 15 ft., then dim light for another 15 ft.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +11 within 5 ft. A hit deals 45 (6d12 + 6) piercing and 14 (4d6) fire. A target of Large size or smaller must pass a DC 18 Dexterity save or be swallowed.
Swallowed creatures. They are Blinded and Restrained, have total cover from outside attacks and effects, and take 42 (12d6) fire damage at the start of each landshark turn. If one creature inside deals 30 damage or more to the landshark in a single turn, the landshark makes a DC 23 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On failure it expels every swallowed creature, Prone within 10 ft. If the landshark dies, a creature inside is no longer Restrained and can exit Prone by spending 15 ft. of movement.
Deadly Leap. After jumping at least 15 ft. during its movement, it can land in a space occupied by one or more other creatures. Each makes a DC 18 Strength or Dexterity save of its choice. On a failure it takes 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning plus 21 (6d6) fire and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is pushed 5 ft. into an unoccupied space it chooses outside the landshark’s space. If no such space is within range, it falls Prone where the landshark lands.
Lava Pool (recharge 6). While on solid ground, melt the area within a 10-ft. radius. Any creature that starts its turn in the pool or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 44 (8d10) fire damage.

lines: Use Young Magma Landshark for the juvenile encounter.

lines: The source gives Lava Pool no duration.

Agile Predator. A creature the manticore hits on its own turn cannot make opportunity attacks against it for the rest of that turn.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack, or two Tail Spike attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. A creature Frightened of the manticore takes another 4 (1d8) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage. The manticore can move the target up to 5 ft. horizontally.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Trumpeting Howl (1/day). Each enemy within 120 ft. that hears the howl makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the manticore for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. If the initial save fails by 5 or more, the creature is also Dazed while Frightened this way.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses only one: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends that turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge remain available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end Dazed. The GM can allow other remedies.

gm.title: Wishes
lines: Wishes are a power of exceptionally potent genies. Choose a limit of one to three wishes for this genie. The requester must be a non-genie creature within 60 ft. and state the desired effect to the genie. The genie can cast Wish on that creature's behalf. Once it grants its limit, choose how long before it can grant wishes again. A year is typical. The same genie can spend its entire allotment on a particular creature only once in that creature's lifetime. A genie may exploit loose wording to its own benefit.

gm.title: Description
lines: The marikith hunters of Timor live in dark tunnels around a queen. They frighten their prey before closing in.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Use small packs outside the hive. In the hive, send two or three hunters first and increase the size of each wave until the hunters outnumber their opponents at least ten to one. The queen remains inside and issues telepathic orders to her brood within 5 miles. Her printed encounter lists an escort of 4–48 hunters.

gm.title: Light sensitivity
lines: All marikith take −1 on attack rolls in candlelight or starlight, −2 in torchlight, and −4 in bright sunlight or within daylight.

gm.title: Hunter tactics
lines: Hunters squeeze through gaps and use mimicry to isolate their prey. To fool a listener, a hunter opposes the listener's Listen check with Bluff and gains a +8 racial bonus on the roll. The queen's bulk prevents her from using the hunters' Compression ability.

gm.title: Transformation
lines: The book presents a failed powers check in Timor as a rumored route to transformation, taking 1d6 hours. The queen's sting provides a separate confirmed encounter mechanic. A humanoid paralyzed by the sting changes into a hunter within a week. Neutralizing the poison before completion reverses the change.

gm.title: Description
lines: A rubbery black hunter slips through drains and barred openings. Packs lure prey with copies of their voices.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Any underground environment in Timor. Pairs, packs of 2–8 or swarms of 2–20. Always lawful evil. No treasure or level adjustment. Advancement 4–5 HD (Medium).

gm.title: Combat statistics
lines: Initiative +8. AC +4 Dex, +3 natural. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. Base attack +2, printed grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +5.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Escape Artist +16, Hide +12, Listen +6, Move Silently +12, Spot +4. Improved Initiative. Racial bonuses: +8 Escape Artist, +4 Hide and Move Silently.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Darkvision 120 ft. Takes half damage from bludgeoning weapons and is immune to fear, horror and madness. Hunters are under the influence of their queen.
Light Sensitivity (Ex). Attack rolls take −1 in candlelight or starlight, −2 in torchlight, and −4 in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +5 melee for 1d4 + 3.
Full attack. Two claws +5 melee for 1d4 + 3 each and bite +0 melee for 2d4 + 3.
Compression (Ex). While moving, pass through a gap at least 1 ft. across as a free action. A gap 7–11 inches across takes a move action. A gap 3–6 inches across takes a full-round action. Smaller gaps are impassable.
Voice Mimicry (Ex). The hunter has no true language but can imitate voices and sounds. Resolve deception with its Bluff check at a +8 racial bonus opposed by the listener’s Listen check.

gm.title: Running the encounter
lines: Hunters torment prey before striking. Outside the hive they hunt in small packs. In the hive the first wave has two or three hunters, and each later wave grows until the intruders are outnumbered at least ten to one.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The single-attack line omits claw damage, so use the matching claw damage in Full Attack. The printed grapple modifier is +3 even though the printed base attack and Strength yield +5 under the usual calculation.

gm.title: Description
lines: This spiderlike queen breeds the hunters of Timor. She stays inside the hive and directs her brood against intruders.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Initiative +1. AC components −2 size, +1 Dex, +10 natural. Touch AC 9, flat-footed AC 18. Base attack +7, grapple +15. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +8, Ref +4, Will +9.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Attack. Claw +15 melee (2d4 + 8).
Full attack. Four claws +15 melee (2d4 + 8 each), plus either bite +10 melee (2d8 + 4 and poison) or sting +10 melee (1d8 + 4 and poison).
Improved Grab (Ex). After at least two claws hit a Medium or smaller target, attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity.
Poison (Ex). Bite and sting both require DC 20 Fortitude saves. For the bite, use 2d6 initial Constitution damage and 1d6 secondary Constitution damage. The sting has no initial damage and causes one week of secondary paralysis. An affected humanoid becomes a marikith hunter during that week. Neutralizing the poison before the change finishes reverses the transformation.

gm.title: Traits
lines: DR 5/piercing. Darkvision 120 ft. Immune to fear, horror, and madness. Hive Mind (Su) lets her communicate telepathically with any of her brood within 5 miles. Light Sensitivity (Ex) imposes a −1 attack penalty in candlelight or starlight, −2 in torchlight, and −4 in bright sunlight or daylight. The block also lists Voice Mimicry.

gm.title: Skills and feats
lines: Balance +9, Hide +5, Listen +10, Move Silently +7, Search +3, Spot +8. Improved Grab, Multiattack.

gm.title: Encounter details
lines: Underground in Timor. A queen is escorted by 4–48 hunters. Always neutral evil. Double standard treasure. Advancement 11–16 HD (Huge).

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The bite description repeats “secondary damage” with two different values. For play, use 2d6 initial and the explicitly repeated 1d6 secondary. The queen has Voice Mimicry in her stat line, but only the hunter entry gives a procedure. As a table default, use opposed Bluff with a +8 racial bonus against Listen, as for the hunters.
The queen’s printed stat line gives a 10-ft. space and +15 grapple. The full-attack line omits bite poison, which is specified in the combat description on p. 150.

gm.title: Description
lines: An inevitable created by Primus to enforce contracts registered at the Hall of Concordance in Sigil. The contract is engraved on a gold plate carried in the marut's chest.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Immutable Form. The marut is immune to spells and effects that change its form.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the marut fails a save, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The marut has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The marut needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Unerring Slam attacks.
Unerring Slam. Melee weapon attack, reach 5 ft., one target. It hits automatically and deals 60 force damage. A Huge or smaller target is pushed up to 5 ft. away from the marut.
Blazing Edict (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cube originating from the marut's chest takes 45 radiant damage. Any creature that takes damage from the edict makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is stunned until the end of the marut's next turn.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines: Plane Shift (3/day). Cast Plane Shift as an action using Intelligence, without material components. Use the spell as written or choose an unwilling creature the marut sees within 60 ft. That creature makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it is sent to a teleportation circle in the Hall of Concordance in Sigil.

gm.title: Contract enforcement
lines: The Kolyarut accepts enforceable contracts, records the agreed terms on a gold plate, and places it in the marut. The marut follows the written terms until the contract is fulfilled, including punishment for breaches. It uses lethal force only if the terms require it, the contract is completely broken, or someone attacks the marut.

gm.title: Description
lines: An immense adranach made by a master spellwright.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Strength saves +14, Dexterity +10, Wisdom +9. Athletics +14, Perception +16. Darkvision 360 ft., passive Perception 26. Speaks its creator’s languages. Natural armor. Resists damage from spells. Immune to poison damage and to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Arcane Nature. It can function without air, food, drink or sleep.
Immutable Form. Its shape cannot be changed by magic or other effects.
Magic Resistance. It rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Magic Weapons. Treat its weapon attacks as magical.
Arcane Leak. Once reduced to half its maximum HP (145), its mask cracks. A creature that starts its turn within 20 ft. of it or first enters that radius on a turn takes 21 (6d6) radiant damage. Casting in the radius requires a DC 18 check with the caster’s spellcasting ability. On failure the spell fails, the slot is expended, and the caster takes 7 (2d6) force damage per slot level.
Colossal Build. Double its carrying capacity and push, drag and lift limits.
Slipstream. It can cast Invisibility on itself at will. Double its speed while Invisible.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). It can turn a failed save into a success.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks and one Tail attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 33 (4d12 + 7) slashing.
Tail. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit for 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning.
Force Bolts (Recharge 5–6). Choose up to six creatures it can see within 120 ft. Each takes 35 (10d6) force damage on a failed DC 22 Dexterity save.

gm.title: Legendary actions
lines:
It has three actions, replenished at the start of its turn. Spend them on one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claws attack.
Vanish (2 actions). Cast Invisibility and move up to its walking or flying speed without doubling the movement from Slipstream.
Starry Burst (3 actions). Each creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 27 (5d10) force damage and leaves the creature Blinded through the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition. The adranach becomes Invisible until its next turn starts or it attacks.

gm.title: Customization
lines: See Adranach for the optional features, including Astral Form and Truesight for a master.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The printed Charisma modifier is +1 for a score of 11. The ability grid uses the standard +0. The book does not specify how Arcane Leak handles a spell cast without a slot.

lines:

On a failure it immediately takes the Attack action and makes one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If no creature is in reach, it makes one ranged attack against a random creature within range, throwing its weapon if necessary.
Feed on the Crowd. When a creature dies within 60 ft., the master gains 15 temporary HP and has advantage on attacks, checks, and saves through the end of its next turn.

Captivating Presence (Recharge 6). Each creature within 120 ft. must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or be charmed by the master for 1 hour. Its speed is 0 while charmed this way. Taking damage lets a charmed creature repeat the save, ending the effect on itself if it succeeds. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to every Master of Cruelties’ Captivating Presence for 24 hours.

lines:

gm.title: Description
lines: A Shadowfell hermit that ambushes travelers with a garrote and drags them through the shadows. Other creatures can then sense the cursed victim.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Garrote. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target of the meazel's size or smaller. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target. Escape requires a DC 13 check with disadvantage. The victim takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the meazel's turns until the grapple ends. The meazel cannot make weapon attacks while it holds a creature this way.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). The meazel, its worn and carried gear, and any creature it grapples teleport up to 500 ft. Both ends must be in dim light or darkness. The meazel must have seen the destination before. It can choose a spot outside its current line of sight. If that space is occupied, the teleport ends in the nearest unoccupied space. Each other creature carried by the teleport is cursed for 1 hour. Remove Curse or Greater Restoration ends the curse early. Until it ends, Undead and creatures native to the Shadowfell within 300 ft. of the cursed creature sense it, so it cannot hide from them.

gm.title: Bonus actions

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Built-in weapon. Use the listed keen greatsword at +17 melee (2d6 + 7), with a second +12 attack on a full attack. Other built-in weapons vary and the blade is always keen.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +6, Dex +8, Con +7. Perception +4, Stealth +8, Survival +4. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Common.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Stat block and lair actions, p. 189.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Stone Gaze and make two attacks in any combination of Snake Bite and Heavy Crossbow.
Snake Bite. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (3d6) poison damage. On a failed DC 15 Constitution save, the target is Poisoned until the end of the medusa's next turn.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +8, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Stone Gaze. Up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. make DC 15 Constitution saves. A failure starts turning the target to stone, reducing its speed by 10 ft. and giving disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves. A save at the end of each of the target's turns ends the effect on success. If it fails another save against Stone Gaze while turning to stone, reduce its speed by another 10 ft. and apply Dazed until the effect ends. If it fails again while turning to stone and Dazed this way, it is Petrified and no longer repeats saves. Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect removes the petrification.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.

gm.title: Lair Actions
lines:
Take one lair action at initiative count 20, losing ties. The same option cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Venom Shower. Center a 10-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high cylinder on a visible point within 90 ft. Each creature in it makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Poisoned through the end of initiative count 20 of the next round.
Shadowstep. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
Stony Wail. Each enemy within 60 ft. that can hear the lair's statues makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Frightened of the medusa through the end of initiative count 20 of the next round.

gm.title: Dazed (MCDM)
lines: On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends the turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

gm.title: Description
lines: Overwhelming fear can bring these crustacean-like fey into being. When several spawn together, a network of moss-lined tunnels may form nearby.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Fear Aura. A Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the meenlock makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened until the start of its next turn.
Light Sensitivity. In bright light, the meenlock has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

gm.title: Actions
lines: Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. The target must pass a DC 11 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). Teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 ft. Both the starting space and destination must be in dim light or darkness. The meenlock can teleport to a space it cannot see.

gm.title: Telepathic Torment mechanics
lines:
Up to four meenlocks can torment one incapacitated creature with telepathy. They can move, act, and react normally, but cannot use telepathy for another purpose during the torment. A creature immune to being frightened is unaffected.
If the target remains incapacitated for 1 hour, it makes a Wisdom save. The DC is 10 plus the number of participating meenlocks that stayed within sight of the target and were never incapacitated during the hour. On a failure, the target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. On a success, it takes half damage. The meenlocks can repeat the process.
A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately becomes a full-health meenlock under the DM's control. Wish or divine intervention can reverse the transformation.

lines:
Casts as a 10th-level sorcerer. Save DC 12 + spell level. Printed spells per day by level 0–5: 6/7/7/6/5/3.
0: daze, dancing lights, detect magic, detect poison, disrupt undead, flare, light, ray of frost, resistance.

gm.title: Fury shared rules
lines:
Printed source. Furies, pp. 79–80. The sisters appear together and speak all humanoid languages. They try three times to divert a target from atonement before trying to kill them in public.
Defenses. Damage reduction 15/good. Immune to paralysis, polymorph, and mind-affecting effects.
Scourge. The +3 scourge works like a whip that deals 1d4 lethal damage before modifiers. A Fury may substitute it for her claw attacks. Use the attack and ability damage listed for that sister. Rake (Ex) is +9 melee for 1d4 + 1 damage.
Alter Self (Sp). At will as a standard action, a Fury can take the form of an elderly human woman indefinitely. Caster level 10.
Breath Weapon (Su, 3/day). Fill one adjacent square with foul air. Apply stinking cloud as cast by an 8th-level sorcerer, with a DC 16 Fortitude save.
Find Penitent (Su). Furies can locate a target who seeks redemption at the invitation or embrace stage of corruption. The target cannot hide from them, even with magic.
Gaseous Death (Su). At 0 HP, a Fury and her scourge dissolve into smoke. Surviving sisters continue to fight, though the last survivor tries to flee. If a sister survives, the slain Furies return at full HP after 24 hours. To kill them permanently, all three must die within the same 24 hours and an Innocent must deal the killing blows. Their scourges remain after permanent death.
Weaknesses. A good cleric or a paladin can turn each Fury separately by invoking her true name. A turning attempt cannot destroy, rebuke, or command her. A Fury cannot deliberately harm a good creature except with her breath weapon.

gm.title: Table notes
lines: The book spells her name Megarea. The single Attack line appears to print 1d4 + 5 scourge damage, while the Full Attack line gives 1d4 + 3. Use 1d4 + 3 in both. Her weapon line calls its effect Intelligence drain, while the combat prose gives Intelligence damage. Use the latter. The listed +3 base attack and +3 grapple are preserved despite her 10 outsider HD.

The book lists polymorph any object as a 4th-level spell, but in 3.5 it is an 8th-level sorcerer spell. Omit it unless the table deliberately adopts the printed exception. The school restriction in the prose also conflicts with the printed spells known.

gm.title: Description
lines: A protective cleric of Valor’s Call. Mercion finds beauty in truth and follows that principle in place of a deity.

gm.title: Armor
lines: Plate armor. Use her printed AC 19.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Special Equipment. Mercion wields a +1 Quarterstaff.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Divine Radiance attack and one +1 Quarterstaff attack. Mercion can cast one spell from Spellcasting in place of either attack.
Divine Radiance. Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d8) radiant damage.
+1 Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack with the printed +4 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) if wielded with two hands.
Radiant Fire (Recharge 5–6). Pick a point Mercion can see within 120 ft. The point erupts in magical radiance. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere around it makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. It takes 28 (8d6) radiant damage on a failure, or half on a success.

1/day. Death Ward.

gm.title: Combat notes
lines: Mercion heals from behind her armor. She uses Radiant Fire only when the blast is clear of allies and bystanders. Otherwise she favors Hold Person or Divine Radiance.

gm.title: Description
lines: These grim ferrymasters navigate the River Styx and wield fiery oars against unwelcome boarders.

gm.title: Damage resistances
lines: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Magic Resistance. The merrenoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Oar attack and use Fear Gaze.
Oar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) fire damage.
Fear Gaze. Choose one creature the merrenoloth can see within 60 ft. It must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of the merrenoloth for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.

gm.title: Spellcasting
lines:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 13). No material components are required.
At will. Charm Person, Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Gust of Wind.
3/day. Control Water.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Teleport. Teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the merrenoloth can see, taking any equipment it wears or carries.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
While captaining a vessel, the merrenoloth can choose one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds. It must be able to act and, if surprised, must first finish its first turn.
Gale. For one round, the air within 60 ft. of the vessel is difficult terrain. A Medium or smaller creature that flies into the area or starts its turn flying there must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone. The gale ends on initiative count 20 of the next round.
Propel. Increase the vessel's speed by 30 ft. until initiative count 20 of the next round.
Repair. The vessel regains 22 (4d10) hit points.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
Choose one or both effects for the vessel.
Unerring. The vessel stays on course for the destination the merrenoloth names.
Unsinkable. The vessel stays afloat even if its hull is breached.
The effects fade over 1d6 hours after the merrenoloth dies.

gm.title: Traits

gm.title: Innate Spellcasting
lines:
Intelligence (spell save DC 13). No material components needed.
At will. Charm Person, Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Gust of Wind.
3/day. Control Water.
1/day. Control Weather.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Use Fear Gaze once and make one Oar attack.
Oar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
Fear Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the merrenoloth for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Teleport. Magically move to a visible, unoccupied space within 60 ft., bringing worn or carried equipment.

gm.title: Lair actions
lines:
A ship becomes the lair when the merrenoloth takes a contract to captain it. When fighting aboard, it can use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds.
Restore 22 (4d10) hit points to the ship.
Wind adds 30 ft. to the ship’s speed until initiative count 20 of the next round.
The air within 60 ft. of the ship becomes difficult terrain until initiative count 20 of the next round. During that time, a Medium or smaller creature that flies into the area or starts its turn flying there must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

gm.title: Regional effects
lines:
The merrenoloth’s ship gains one or more of these effects.
The hull can be breached without sinking the ship.
The ship stays on course for the destination the merrenoloth names.
Passengers it chooses to take aboard are comfortable through wind and weather but remain subject to damage.
If the merrenoloth dies, these effects fade over 1d6 hours.

lines:
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Adhesive (object form only). Anything that touches the mimic sticks to it. A Huge or smaller creature stuck this way is Grappled (escape DC 13) and has Disadvantage on checks to escape.

gm.title: Actions
lines:

gm.title: Bonus actions
lines: Shape-Shift. Take the appearance of a Medium or Small object, or resume the mimic's true blob form. Both forms use the same statistics. Everything the mimic wears or carries keeps its shape.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: An amorphous shapechanger that can resemble an oak chest or other object, then reveal a toothy maw and reaching pseudopods.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Deception +2, Stealth +5. Immune to acid damage and bludgeoning damage from falling. Immune to Prone. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
False Appearance (object form). A motionless mimic passes for an ordinary object.
Mimicry. The mimic can imitate sounds it has heard, including voices. A listener can recognize the imitation with a DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit this way is Grappled (escape DC 13).
Gnashing Maw. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. If the mimic is grappling the target, deal an extra 3 (1d6) acid damage.
Shapechanger. The mimic can become a Small, Medium, or Large object or return to its true amorphous form. Its size is the only statistic that changes. Worn or carried gear keeps its shape. On death the mimic resumes its true form.
Envelop. While grappling a creature, the mimic uses Shapechanger to become an object at least as large as that creature if it is not already in such a form. The creature is then enveloped and its grapple ends. It cannot breathe, is Blinded and Restrained, and has total cover from attacks and effects outside the mimic. It moves with the mimic and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the mimic’s turns.
The mimic can envelop one creature at a time. An engulfed creature can spend an action to make a DC 13 Strength check, escaping into an empty space of its choice within 5 ft. of the mimic on a success. It also escapes automatically if the mimic uses Shapechanger or Panic Shift, becomes Incapacitated, or dies.

gm.title: Reactions
lines: Panic Shift (1/day). When it takes damage, the mimic releases any Grappled or enveloped creatures and becomes a Small, dense, spiked object. In this form its walking and climbing speeds double, it resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks, and its actions are limited to Dash, Disengage, and Shapechanger. A creature within 5 ft. that touches it or hits it with a melee attack takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage. This ends when the mimic dies or uses Shapechanger to take another form.

lines: A Bigger Mimic can use the same ambush tactics at building scale.

gm.title: Hit point rule
lines: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: An amorphous companion that can wrap itself around its caregiver in the guise of clothing, such as a folded traveling cloak.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor 13 + PB. Dexterity save +1 + PB. Stealth +1 + PB. Acid damage immunity. Immune to Prone. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11.

gm.title: Caregiver scaling
lines: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.

gm.title: Traits
lines: False Appearance (object form). A motionless mimic passes for an ordinary object.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Shapechanger. As an action, the mimic can become a Small, Medium, or Large object or return to its amorphous form. Only its size changes. Its gear stays unchanged. It returns to its true form if it dies.
Signature Attack (Bite). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.

gm.title: Ferocity actions
lines:
Level 1, Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack. On a hit, the next attack against the target before the start of the mimic’s next turn has advantage.
Level 3, Adhesive Pseudopods (5 Ferocity). Choose any creatures within 5 ft. Each makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB or is Grappled (escape DC 10 + PB).
Level 5, I’m You (8 Ferocity). Use Shapechanger to copy one Large or smaller creature the mimic sees within 5 ft. Only size changes, and the mimic reverts to its previous form at the start of its next turn. After transforming it can make a signature attack against the creature it copied. Hit or miss, the creature then makes a Wisdom save against DC 10 + PB. On a failure, until the start of the mimic’s next turn it has disadvantage on attacks and saves, and attacks against it have advantage.

gm.title: Bonus Actions
lines:
Wearable Companion. Within 5 ft. of its caregiver, the mimic can enter the caregiver’s space, cover them, and take the form of clothing. Its space is not difficult terrain for the caregiver, who gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. While neither is Incapacitated, the caregiver can change the clothing’s appearance at will without an action.
An attack that hits either the caregiver or the worn mimic hits both, and both take the full damage and effects. While worn, the mimic cannot move and can only use a bonus action to revert to its previous form. It also reverts automatically if it enters a rampage. On reverting, it stops being worn and enters the nearest unoccupied space of its choice.

gm.title: MCDM companion rules
lines:
Shared turn. The caregiver and companion act on the same turn. The companion moves and uses its reaction and bonus action independently. To do anything with its action besides Dash, Disengage or Dodge, it normally needs a command that costs the caregiver a bonus action. It must see or hear the caregiver. If the caregiver is Incapacitated, it can act without a command. The GM chooses who controls it when the caregiver is Incapacitated or absent.
Ferocity. At the start of their turn, unless Incapacitated, the companion gains 1d4 Ferocity plus one for each enemy it sees or hears within 5 ft. A swarm sharing one stat block counts as one enemy. Spend the listed cost before taking a Ferocity action. It uses the companion’s action, requires the listed caregiver level and is unavailable during a rampage.
Rampage. After rolling Ferocity, a companion with at least 10 Ferocity risks a rampage if it is not Incapacitated. A caregiver who is not Incapacitated and can be seen or heard can prevent it with a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check against DC 5 + Ferocity, without spending an action. If the companion rampages, it immediately moves toward the nearest creature it senses and makes its signature attack, with extra damage equal to half its Ferocity on a hit. If an ally and enemy tie for nearest, roll any die. On an odd roll the caregiver’s player chooses a tied ally. On an even roll they choose a tied enemy. If it cannot reach a target, it Dashes toward it. If it senses none, it moves as far as it can in a random safe direction. Ferocity falls to 0 after this action or at the end of the turn.
Recovery. At 0 HP, a companion makes death saves. After combat, Ferocity resets to 0. A companion that is not dying first regains HP equal to its remaining Ferocity.

gm.title: Appearance
lines: A small amorphous shapechanger that can masquerade as a palm-sized lockbox, with tiny teeth and sticky pseudopods.

gm.title: Other statistics
lines: Natural armor. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. No languages.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
In Your Space. The mimiature and another creature can occupy the same space. It can pass through openings at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save reduces the mimiature to 0 HP. Other damage kills it if it reaches 8 damage. It ignores smaller amounts from those other effects.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Sticky Swarm (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 bludgeoning damage. Through the end of its next turn, the target has disadvantage on checks and saves to escape the Grappled condition and advantage on checks to initiate or maintain a grapple. If at least three mimiatures join the attack, for the same duration the target cannot cast spells with somatic components, drop objects, or interact with objects it is not already holding.
Group Shapechanger. A mimiature can turn into a Tiny object or return to its amorphous form. Four mimiatures within 5 ft. of one another can use this action together to become one Small object. Gear stays unchanged. The combined form breaks if any member moves, takes an action, or dies, returning its members to their true forms.

gm.title: Minion rules
lines:
Group attack. Two to five mimiatures on the same turn can each spend an action to attack one target within reach of all of them. Roll once at +3 plus the number joining. A hit deals 1 bludgeoning damage per mimiature. A lone mimiature uses +3. Advantage or disadvantage applies only if all participants have it. Roll for separate groups if cover or concealment differs. The target chooses a single participant for responses that only affect one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If a creature provokes from multiple mimiatures at the same time, each can spend its reaction to join. Mimiatures have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. If a weapon hit deals more than 8 damage, apply the surplus to other eligible mimiatures, dropping one to 0 HP for each 8 surplus damage or fraction of 8. In melee, they must be within the weapon’s reach. At range, they must be on the line through the original target within the weapon’s short range. Opportunity attacks cannot deal overkill damage.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Castle Drakken, pp. 181, 183. Tower Dragon traits, Appendix A, p. 198. Seals and Crown, Appendix D, p. 233.

gm.title: Base stat block
lines: Ancient Bronze Dragon, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). Add the Tower Dragon’s guardian traits from Appendix A. The palace encounter adds the trigger distance, patrol limits, and response to a Seal of Drakkenheim. Use the ancient dragon’s CR 22.

gm.title: Traits
lines:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Constructed Nature. Needs no food, air, drink, or sleep.
False Appearance. While still, he resembles an inanimate bronze statue.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. May use Frightful Presence, then makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage.

Repulsion Breath. Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 23 Strength save or are pushed 60 ft. away.

gm.title: Legendary Actions
lines:

Detect. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.

gm.title: Encounter notes
lines: He attacks intruders who approach within 150 ft. of the palace. He cannot follow them inside and stops pursuit at the castle grounds. He ignores creatures attuned to a Seal of Drakkenheim unless they attack him or cast a spell on him, in which case he ignores that protection for 24 hours. An action presenting a seal within 30 ft. can rebuke him if he can see or hear the presenter and loses a contested Charisma check. He cannot move or take actions or reactions for 1 minute or until he takes damage. If he wins the check, he is immune to that creature’s rebuke for 24 hours. He obeys the wearer of the Crown of Westemär. Wish alone restores his sanity.

gm.title: Description
lines: An elder brain can convert a stunned beholder in its brine pool into a mindwitness. The colony uses it to relay messages telepathically.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tentacles attack, or use Eye Ray three times.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) psychic damage. A Large or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 13) and must pass a DC 13 Intelligence save or be restrained until the grapple ends.
Eye Ray. Roll a d6 to choose a magical ray and reroll any result already used this turn. Choose one target the mindwitness can see within 120 ft.

gm.title: Printed source
lines: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 181.

gm.title: Eye Ray outcomes mechanics
lines:
Aversion Ray (1). On a failed DC 13 Charisma save, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Fear Ray (2). On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.
Psychic Ray (3). The target takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage on a failed DC 13 Intelligence save.
Slowing Ray (4). On a failed DC 13 Dexterity save, the creature's speed is halved for 1 minute. During that time, it cannot take reactions and can take at most one action or one bonus action on each turn. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Stunning Ray (5). On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the creature is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.
Telekinetic Ray (6). On a failed DC 13 Strength save, move a creature up to 30 ft. in any direction and restrain it until the start of the mindwitness's next turn or until the mindwitness is incapacitated. An unworn and uncarried object of up to 300 lb. can be moved up to 30 ft. in any direction. The ray can also manipulate an object precisely, such as opening a door or using a simple tool.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions of the same stat block normally share a turn and can all move before taking their actions. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice to spend.
A minion drops to 0 HP if an attack damages it or it takes damage from failing a save. Other damage kills it if the damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise the minion ignores that damage.
Overkill. When a weapon hit deals more damage than a minion’s maximum HP, apply the excess to an additional minion of the same stat block, as weapon attack damage. Repeat while damage remains after subtracting each target’s maximum HP. Melee targets must be within reach of the attack. Ranged targets must lie along the line of the attack and within the weapon’s normal range. Opportunity attacks cannot overkill.
Group attack. Two to five minions of the same stat block sharing a turn can each spend their action to make one attack if the target is within reach or range of each participant. Roll once, adding +1 for each participant, and multiply the fixed damage by that same count on a hit. Use advantage or disadvantage only if it applies to everyone in the group. Split groups when the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion can make a group attack alone using its listed attack bonus and damage. If multiple eligible minions could make the same melee opportunity attack, they can each use their reaction to join one group attack. If the group attack triggers an effect against a single attacker, its target chooses which participating minion it affects.

lines: Goring Horns (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 piercing damage. If at least two lackeys joined the attack, the target makes a Strength save with DC 10 plus the number of participants. On a failure, move the target horizontally 5 ft. per participating lackey.

gm.title: MCDM minion rules
lines:
Minions with the same stat block can share a turn. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice.
Group attacks. Two to five minions sharing a turn can spend their actions on a single attack against a target in every participant’s range or reach. Add +1 to the roll per participant. On a hit, multiply the listed damage by the number of participants. Only use advantage or disadvantage when it applies to everyone involved. Split groups if the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion attacking alone uses its printed bonus and damage. Eligible minions can each spend a reaction to join the same group opportunity attack. If a reaction or similar effect from the target would affect one attacker, the target chooses which participant it affects.
Overkill. A weapon attack that deals more damage than the minion’s maximum HP can apply the excess to another minion with the same block. Keep subtracting each extra target’s HP from the excess to find what carries over. Extra melee targets must be in reach. Extra ranged targets must be on the attack’s line and within the weapon’s short range. An opportunity attack cannot overkill.

gm.title: Description
lines: Ravenloft’s own fog gathers into an elemental. It hides in banks of mist and pursues prey through the air.

gm.title: Classification
lines: Medium Elemental (Air, Mists). Medium size tier shown in header.

gm.title: Medium size tier
lines:
Medium elemental (Air, Mists). CR 3. 26 HP (4d8 + 8). Initiative +9. Speed Fly 100 ft. (perfect).
AC 18, touch 15, flat-footed 13. Base attack +3, grapple +4. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Attack Slam +8 melee (1d6 + 1). Full attack Slam +8 melee (1d6 + 1).
Fort +3, Ref +9, Will +1. Str 12, Dex 21, Con 14, Int 5, Wis 11, Cha 13. Listen +7, Spot +7.
Feats include Dodge, Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative (bonus), Weapon Finesse (bonus). Advancement 5–7 HD, Medium.

gm.title: Actions
lines:
Slam. Make one melee slam, or use the full-attack count in the chosen tier.
Air Mastery (Ex). Airborne attackers take −1 on attack and damage rolls against the elemental.
Infuse Evil (Su). As a standard action, the elemental tries to enter the target’s lungs. On a failed DC 15 Fortitude save, the target attempts a Will save at DC equal to half the elemental’s HD plus its Charisma modifier. A failed Will save makes the target neutral evil for 2d8 minutes. The target attempts the same Will save when the duration ends. Success restores the original alignment. Failure leaves the new alignment in place until reversed by atonement.

gm.title: Traits
lines: Darkvision 60 ft. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, critical hits, and flanking. Does not eat, sleep, or breathe. It cannot be raised or resurrected, though limited wish, wish, miracle, or true resurrection can restore it. Misty Appearance (Ex). In fog it can hide as though invisible.
